cobbleeffort.species.dullahamon.desc: A headless knight riding a ghost horse. Its green flames burn without heat and wither the living.
cobbleeffort.species.dullahamon.name: Dullahamon
cobbleeffort.species.duramon.desc: A living holy sword. It forges itself sharper with every battle it survives.
cobbleeffort.species.duramon.name: Duramon
cobbleeffort.species.durandamon.desc: The holy sword perfected. Its lance-sword cuts through anything, even light.
cobbleeffort.species.durandamon.name: Durandamon
cobbleeffort.species.duskmon.desc: A warrior of darkness covered in staring eyes. Its red blades cut down anything its many eyes see.
cobbleeffort.species.duskmon.name: Duskmon
cobbleeffort.species.dynasmon.desc: A Royal Knight born from a wyvern. Its great claws and wings make it the bravest fighter of its order.
cobbleeffort.species.dynasmon.name: Dynasmon
cobbleeffort.species.dynasmonxantibody.d: Dynasmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its dark armour hums with teal light, and its claws grow ever sharper.
cobbleeffort.species.ebemon.desc: A grey alien cyborg from beyond the network. It studies other Digimon with its probes before blasting them.
cobbleeffort.species.ebemon.name: EBEmon
cobbleeffort.species.ebemonxantibody.des: EBEmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its capsule tanks power a cannon that fires bolts of teal lightning.
cobbleeffort.species.ebiburgamon.desc: A little axolotl wearing a burger bun. It loves shrimp burgers more than anything else in the world.
cobbleeffort.species.ebiburgamon.name: Ebi Burgamon
cobbleeffort.species.ebidramon.desc: A lobster dragon of the deep. Its huge claws can crush a ship's hull like an eggshell.
cobbleeffort.species.ebidramon.name: Ebidramon
cobbleeffort.species.ekakimon.desc: A living colour pencil. It draws on anything it finds, and its doodles sometimes come to life.
cobbleeffort.species.ekakimon.name: Ekakimon
cobbleeffort.species.eldoradimon.desc: A colossal tortoise that carries a lost city of gold on its back. Whole tribes of Digimon live on its shell.
cobbleeffort.species.eldoradimon.name: El Doradimon
cobbleeffort.species.elecmon.desc: A lively little beast whose tail feathers crackle with electricity. It looks after baby Digimon on File Island.
cobbleeffort.species.elecmon.name: Elecmon
cobbleeffort.species.elecmonviolet.desc: A violet Elecmon with a mischievous streak. Its yellow-streaked tail gives a nasty shock.
cobbleeffort.species.elecmonviolet.name: Elecmon (Violet)
cobbleeffort.species.elephamon.desc: An armoured war elephant. The turbines on its shoulders let it charge with the force of a train.
cobbleeffort.species.elephamon.name: Elephamon
cobbleeffort.species.elizamon.desc: A frilled lizard pup. It spreads its frill wide to look bigger than it is.
cobbleeffort.species.elizamon.name: Elizamon
cobbleeffort.species.enbarrmon.desc: A spectral warhorse of the Royal Knights. Its ghostly hooves never touch the ground.
cobbleeffort.species.enbarrmon.name: Enbarrmon
cobbleeffort.species.enmamon.desc: The judge of the underworld. Its mirror shows every deed a Digimon has done, and its verdict is final.
cobbleeffort.species.enmamon.name: Enmamon
cobbleeffort.species.entmon.desc: A rotting tree dragon. Its crimson leaves fall wherever it goes, and the ground withers under them.
cobbleeffort.species.entmon.name: Entmon
cobbleeffort.species.eosmonadult.desc: A program of light and crystal born on the network. It reaches out to Digimon, searching for a friend.
cobbleeffort.species.eosmonadult.name: Eosmon (Adult)
cobbleeffort.species.eosmonperfect.desc: Eosmon grown vast. Its crystal wings span the network, and its light swallows all data around it.
cobbleeffort.species.eosmonperfect.name: Eosmon (Perfect)
cobbleeffort.species.eosmonultimate.desc: Eosmon in its final form. Its rainbow crystal blades can rewrite the network itself.
cobbleeffort.species.eosmonultimate.name: Eosmon (Ultimate)
cobbleeffort.species.erlangmon.desc: A god warrior with a three-pointed spear and a loyal spirit hound. Its third eye sees every deception.
cobbleeffort.species.erlangmon.name: Erlangmon
Erlangmon unleashing its full power. Its crystal trident commands the rivers and the rain.
cobbleeffort.species.espimon.desc: A little spy robot with a jetpack. It sneaks into enemy bases and reports everything it sees.
cobbleeffort.species.espimon.name: Espimon
cobbleeffort.species.etemon.desc: The self-styled king of Digimon rock and roll. It sings so badly that its foes collapse in despair.
cobbleeffort.species.etemon.name: Etemon
cobbleeffort.species.etemonchaos.desc: Etemon fused with the network's cables. It plugs into anything and drains its data dry.
cobbleeffort.species.etemonchaos.name: Etemon Chaos
cobbleeffort.species.evilmon.desc: A little devil with an enormous mouth. It loves to scare others and laughs loudly at its own tricks.
cobbleeffort.species.evilmon.name: Evilmon
cobbleeffort.species.examon.desc: The dragon Royal Knight, the mightiest of all dragons. Its lance Ambitious can pierce the sky.
cobbleeffort.species.examon.name: Examon
cobbleeffort.species.examonxantibody.des: Examon awakened by the X-Antibody, standing as a dragon knight with a blade of green light.
cobbleeffort.species.exermon.desc: A wasp warrior with four bladed arms. It strikes so fast its blades leave green streaks of light.
cobbleeffort.species.exermon.name: Exermon
cobbleeffort.species.exmaquinamon.desc: The god from the machine. Its wings of gold and steel decide the outcome of any battle it joins.
cobbleeffort.species.exmaquinamon.name: Ex Maquinamon
cobbleeffort.species.exogrimmon.desc: An armoured dragon of ruin. Its golden wings spread like the dawn before the end of the world.
cobbleeffort.species.exogrimmon.name: Exo Grimmon
cobbleeffort.species.extyranomon.desc: A stuffed-toy tyrannosaur. Something glows deep inside its mouth, and no one dares to look closer.
cobbleeffort.species.extyranomon.name: Ex-Tyranomon
cobbleeffort.species.eyesmon.desc: A shadow dragon covered in staring eyes. Nothing can hide from it, not even in total darkness.
cobbleeffort.species.eyesmon.name: Eyesmon
Eyesmon scattered into living shadow. It slips through cracks and rises behind its prey.
cobbleeffort.species.fairimon.desc: The Legendary Warrior of wind's human spirit. She dances on the wind, and her sweet voice hides razor-sharp gusts.
cobbleeffort.species.fairimon.name: Fairimon
cobbleeffort.species.falcomon.desc: A little owl trained in the ninja arts. It cannot fly, but it moves so quietly that no one hears it coming.
cobbleeffort.species.falcomon.name: Falcomon
cobbleeffort.species.fangmon.desc: A hound of calamity bound in leather straps. Freed, it tears through anything with its enormous fangs.
cobbleeffort.species.fangmon.name: Fangmon
cobbleeffort.species.fantomon.desc: A grim reaper that drifts through the dark. Its golden scythe reaps the data of anyone whose time has come.
cobbleeffort.species.fantomon.name: Fantomon
cobbleeffort.species.fenriloogamon.desc: A colossal wolf of blue spirit fire, said to devour even the sun and moon. Its howl freezes the hearts of gods.
cobbleeffort.species.fenriloogamon.name: Fenriloogamon
cobbleeffort.species.fenriloogamontakemi: Fenriloogamon bearing a thunder god's sword in its jaws. Green lightning crackles from its blade and thrusters.
cobbleeffort.species.ficusmon.desc: A strangler-fig parasite. It wraps its host in huge aerial roots and slowly saps it of data.
cobbleeffort.species.ficusmon.name: Ficusmon
cobbleeffort.species.filmon.desc: A porcupine beast-man whose golden quills stand up when it fights. Its bandaged fists strike faster than the eye can follow.
cobbleeffort.species.filmon.name: Filmon
cobbleeffort.species.firamon.desc: A young flaming lion that soars on wings of fire. It dives on its foes trailing a comet of flame.
cobbleeffort.species.firamon.name: Firamon
cobbleeffort.species.fladramon.desc: The Armor Digimon of courage. Its fists burst into flames, and its claws can cut through steel.
cobbleeffort.species.fladramon.name: Fladramon
cobbleeffort.species.flamon.desc: The Legendary Warrior of flame's child form. Hot-headed and brave, it never backs down from a fight.
cobbleeffort.species.flamon.name: Flamon
cobbleeffort.species.flarelizamon.desc: A Lizamon blazing with fire. Its flaming fur burns hot enough to melt rock.
cobbleeffort.species.flarelizamon.name: Flare Lizamon
cobbleeffort.species.flaremon.desc: A lion-man who carries the sun in his mane. His roar sets the battlefield ablaze.
cobbleeffort.species.flaremon.name: Flaremon
cobbleeffort.species.flawizarmon.desc: A wizard of flame whose hat burns with eternal fire. It casts blue fireballs from the palm of its hand.
cobbleeffort.species.flawizarmon.name: Fla Wizarmon
cobbleeffort.species.floramon.desc: A little flower Digimon. When it is cornered it scatters pollen that makes its foes sneeze until they give up.
cobbleeffort.species.floramon.name: Floramon
cobbleeffort.species.fluffymon.desc: A puffball of green down. It bounces along trying to fly, and falls asleep where it lands.
cobbleeffort.species.fluffymon.name: Fluffymon
cobbleeffort.species.flybeemon.desc: An armoured hornet warrior. It strikes from above with its stinger and is gone before the foe turns.
cobbleeffort.species.flybeemon.name: Flybeemon
cobbleeffort.species.flymon.desc: A giant wasp whose wings make a deafening drone. Its stinger is loaded with paralysing venom.
cobbleeffort.species.flymon.name: Flymon
cobbleeffort.species.footmon.desc: An android striker. Its shots on goal glow with energy and can knock a whole team flat.
cobbleeffort.species.footmon.name: Footmon
cobbleeffort.species.forgebeemon.desc: A forge bee built like a wrecking ball. Its drill arm and grabber claw can take apart a building.
cobbleeffort.species.forgebeemon.name: Forgebeemon
cobbleeffort.species.frimon.desc: A tiny frilled baby. When it is surprised it spreads its golden frill wide to look scary.
cobbleeffort.species.frimon.name: Frimon
cobbleeffort.species.frogmon.desc: A frog that wears a giant leaf as a hat. It flies around with the propeller on its back pack.
cobbleeffort.species.frogmon.name: Frogmon
cobbleeffort.species.frosvelgrmon.desc: A frost bird of legend. The glowing plumes of its tail scatter a blizzard that freezes everything it touches.
cobbleeffort.species.frosvelgrmon.name: Fros Velgrmon
cobbleeffort.species.frozomon.desc: A snowplough machine-beast. It ploughs through snowdrifts and foes alike, its furnace roaring.
cobbleeffort.species.frozomon.name: Frozomon
cobbleeffort.species.fufumon.desc: A soft apricot wisp with a little red horn. It drifts after anyone who smiles at it.
cobbleeffort.species.fufumon.name: Fufumon
cobbleeffort.species.fugamon.desc: An oni wearing a tiger-skin loincloth. It smashes everything in its way with its great bone club.
cobbleeffort.species.fugamon.name: Fugamon
cobbleeffort.species.fujamon.desc: A horned fish with a toothy grin. It leaps from the water to bite anything that comes near.
cobbleeffort.species.fujamon.name: Fujamon
cobbleeffort.species.fujinmon.desc: A wind god in green armour. The gatling on its arm fires storms of compressed wind.
cobbleeffort.species.fujinmon.name: Fujinmon
cobbleeffort.species.fujitsumon.desc: A shy little shellfish Digimon. It watches the world with its three round eyes.
cobbleeffort.species.fujitsumon.name: Fujitsumon
cobbleeffort.species.fukamon.desc: A golden puff of smoke. It giggles and drifts wherever the wind takes it.
cobbleeffort.species.fukamon.name: Fukamon
cobbleeffort.species.fumamon.desc: A cyborg ninja of the shadows. It strikes with three katana and vanishes before the foe falls.
cobbleeffort.species.fumamon.name: Fumamon
cobbleeffort.species.funbeemon.desc: A chubby little bumblebee. Its big claws are surprisingly strong, and its sting packs a punch.
cobbleeffort.species.funbeemon.name: Funbeemon
cobbleeffort.species.fusamon.desc: A sleepy fluffball pup. It naps almost all day and wakes up only for food.
cobbleeffort.species.fusamon.name: Fusamon
cobbleeffort.species.fuxishou.desc: A pale flying-squirrel beast. It glides between trees on its striped membranes.
cobbleeffort.species.fuxishou.name: Fuxishou
cobbleeffort.species.gabumon.desc: A shy reptile who wears a Garurumon's pelt. It is timid, but brave when its friends are in danger.
cobbleeffort.species.gabumon.name: Gabumon
cobbleeffort.species.gabumonblack.desc: A Gabumon in a dark pelt. Far less shy than its cousin, it picks fights with anything it meets.
cobbleeffort.species.gabumonblack.name: Gabumon (Black)
cobbleeffort.species.gabumonxantibody.de: Gabumon awakened by the X-Antibody. It grew huge and round, and its pelt barely covers it any more.
cobbleeffort.species.gabumonyujonokizuna: Gabumon's form born of the bond of friendship. Its golden discs guide a storm of homing missiles.
cobbleeffort.species.gaioumon.desc: A dragon-man samurai who wanders battlefields in search of strong foes. Its twin blades cut through anything.
cobbleeffort.species.gaioumon.name: Gaioumon
cobbleeffort.species.gaioumonittomode.de: Gaioumon wielding its single great sword. Each swing calls down red lightning.
cobbleeffort.species.galemon.desc: A bird-dragon born in a storm. Its beating wings whip up gales that can uproot trees.
cobbleeffort.species.galemon.name: Galemon
cobbleeffort.species.galgomon.desc: A rabbit beast-man with gatling guns for hands. It fires first and asks questions later.
cobbleeffort.species.galgomon.name: Galgomon
cobbleeffort.species.gallantmonchaosmode: A rare mode of Chaos Dukemon clad in deep blue armour, its lance and wings of translucent light.
cobbleeffort.species.gammamon.desc: A curious little beast who loves to play. It gets into trouble wherever it goes.
cobbleeffort.species.gammamon.name: Gammamon
cobbleeffort.species.ganemon.desc: A walking coin. It is obsessed with money and tries to buy its way out of every fight.
cobbleeffort.species.ganemon.name: Ganemon
cobbleeffort.species.ganimon.desc: A crab Digimon that lives in the shallows. It pinches anyone who steps on it.
cobbleeffort.species.ganimon.name: Ganimon
cobbleeffort.species.ganimonxantibody.de: Ganimon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its huge claw can cut a rope in a single snip.
cobbleeffort.species.gankoomon.desc: The Royal Knight who fights as a man. His spirit Hinukamuy fights at his side with flaming fists.
cobbleeffort.species.gankoomon.name: Gankoomon
Gankoomon awakened by the X-Antibody. His fighting spirit burns as golden flames around him.
cobbleeffort.species.ganvivormon.desc: A nurse-cat who rides in a medicine capsule. Its capsule bites anyone who refuses their medicine.
cobbleeffort.species.ganvivormon.name: Ganvivormon
cobbleeffort.species.gaogamon.desc: A wolf-beast that boxes with its fists. Its rolling punches can knock down a tree.
cobbleeffort.species.gaogamon.name: Gaogamon
cobbleeffort.species.gaomon.desc: A pup who trains as a boxer. It practises its punches all day, dreaming of being the champion.
cobbleeffort.species.gaomon.name: Gaomon
cobbleeffort.species.gaossmon.desc: A shark-headed little dinosaur that swims through the earth and bursts out to bite.
cobbleeffort.species.gaossmon.name: Gaossmon
cobbleeffort.species.gargamon.desc: A little crow wrapped in rags. It hoards shiny things it finds in the rubbish.
cobbleeffort.species.gargamon.name: Gargamon
cobbleeffort.species.gargomon.desc: A gargoyle beast-machine bound in steel. It watches over ruins from rooftops.
cobbleeffort.species.gargomon.name: Gargomon
cobbleeffort.species.garudamon.desc: A great bird-man said to be the guardian of the sky. Its blazing wings scatter darkness.
cobbleeffort.species.garudamon.name: Garudamon
Garudamon awakened by the X-Antibody. It charges with its lance, faster than the wind.
cobbleeffort.species.garummon.desc: The Legendary Warrior of light's beast spirit. It races across the battlefield like a beam of light.
cobbleeffort.species.garummon.name: Garummon
cobbleeffort.species.garurumon.desc: A lone wolf whose fur is as hard as steel. Its blue fox-fire breath can freeze anything.
cobbleeffort.species.garurumon.name: Garurumon
cobbleeffort.species.garurumonblack.desc: A Garurumon with black fur. It hunts alone by night.
cobbleeffort.species.garurumonblack.name: Garurumon (Black)
Garurumon awakened by the X-Antibody. Great steel spikes grew along its back.
cobbleeffort.species.gasamon.desc: A wandering octopus who carries a katana. It hides its face under its huge straw hat.
cobbleeffort.species.gasamon.name: Gasamon
cobbleeffort.species.gattaiancientvolcam: Ancient Volcamon set ablaze when its spirits combine. It erupts in flames from head to toe.
cobbleeffort.species.gattaililithmon.des: A Demon Lord combined with another's power. Its whip carries a mask that drains the strength of its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.gawappamon.desc: A punk kappa who loves loud music. It spins the disc on its head as it dances.
cobbleeffort.species.gawappamon.name: Gawappamon
cobbleeffort.species.gazimon.desc: A sly beast that loves mischief. It tricks travellers and runs off with their things.
cobbleeffort.species.gazimon.name: Gazimon
cobbleeffort.species.gazimonxantibody.de: Gazimon awakened by the X-Antibody. It stands upright and slashes with long black claws.
cobbleeffort.species.gcutemon.desc: Cutemon riding into battle on a turtle-beast with a war drum. It fancies itself a gallant knight.
cobbleeffort.species.gcutemon.name: G-Cutemon
cobbleeffort.species.gekkomon.desc: A cheeky gecko that sticks to walls with its padded paws. It licks anything it is curious about.
cobbleeffort.species.gekkomon.name: Gekkomon
cobbleeffort.species.gekomon.desc: A musician frog who serves at Shogungekomon's castle. It plays its horn day and night.
cobbleeffort.species.gekomon.name: Gekomon
cobbleeffort.species.gemmon.desc: A little creature that rides a cloud studded with gems. The diamond on its brow sparkles when it is happy.
cobbleeffort.species.gemmon.name: Gemmon
cobbleeffort.species.generamon.desc: A mysterious Digimon known only from an old virtual-pet sprite. Nobody is sure what it really looks like.
cobbleeffort.species.generamon.name: Generamon
cobbleeffort.species.geogreymon.desc: The Greymon of DATS. Its horned helmet and powerful legs let it charge through any wall.
cobbleeffort.species.geogreymon.name: Geo Greymon
cobbleeffort.species.gerbemon.desc: A creature that lives in a rubbish bin. It fires junk at its foes from its spray-bottle bazooka.
cobbleeffort.species.gerbemon.name: Gerbemon
cobbleeffort.species.geremon.desc: A yellow slime that crawls through sewers. It throws filth at anyone who comes near.
cobbleeffort.species.geremon.name: Geremon
cobbleeffort.species.gesomon.desc: A squid-beast of the deep sea. It grabs ships with its long clawed arms and drags them under.
cobbleeffort.species.gesomon.name: Gesomon
cobbleeffort.species.gesomonxantibody.de: Gesomon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its tentacles grew mouths of their own.
cobbleeffort.species.ghilliedhumon.desc: A sniper hidden in a suit of living moss. It waits motionless for days for the perfect shot.
cobbleeffort.species.ghilliedhumon.name: Ghilliedhumon
cobbleeffort.species.ghostmon.desc: A little ghost of blue flame. It plays pranks at night and giggles from under its hat.
cobbleeffort.species.ghostmon.name: Ghostmon
cobbleeffort.species.gigabreakdramon.des: Breakdramon rebuilt as a giant. It levels whole cities with its twin drill heads.
cobbleeffort.species.gigadramon.desc: A cyborg dragon twin of Megadramon. It fires missiles from its arms in a fury.
cobbleeffort.species.gigadramon.name: Gigadramon
cobbleeffort.species.giganticnumemon.des: An enormous Numemon. It is so big it can barely move, but nothing can push it away.
cobbleeffort.species.giganticpumpmon.des: A giant jack-o'-lantern that carries a basket of treats. It only appears on Halloween night.
cobbleeffort.species.gigaseadramon.desc: An armoured sea dragon that rules the ocean depths. Its coils can crush a battleship.
cobbleeffort.species.gigaseadramon.name: Giga Seadramon
cobbleeffort.species.gigasmon.desc: The Legendary Warrior of earth's beast spirit. Its enormous fists shake the ground with every blow.
cobbleeffort.species.gigasmon.name: Gigasmon
cobbleeffort.species.gigawarumonzaemon.d: A monstrous teddy-bear chef. It serves its foes a 'special course' with its giant pizza cutter.
cobbleeffort.species.gigimon.desc: A round red baby with tall ears. It bites anything, including its own tail.
cobbleeffort.species.gigimon.name: Gigimon
cobbleeffort.species.ginkakumon.desc: The silver-horned oni of the Saiyu Warriors. Its gourd can swallow foes who answer when it calls their name.
cobbleeffort.species.ginkakumon.name: Ginkakumon
cobbleeffort.species.ginkakumonpromote.d: Ginkakumon promoted in rank. Its armour shines gold and it fights with renewed fury.
cobbleeffort.species.ginryumon.desc: An armoured dragon steed. It charges into battle like a mounted samurai.
cobbleeffort.species.ginryumon.name: Ginryumon
cobbleeffort.species.giromon.desc: A living mine. It explodes on its foes and then reassembles itself.
cobbleeffort.species.giromon.name: Giromon
cobbleeffort.species.gizamon.desc: A spiny amphibian that lurks in the shallows. Its fin-spikes cut through the water like blades.
cobbleeffort.species.gizamon.name: Gizamon
cobbleeffort.species.gizmonat.desc: A war machine made to hunt Digimon. Its blade fins drain data from anything they touch.
cobbleeffort.species.gizmonat.name: Gizmon: AT
cobbleeffort.species.gizmonxt.desc: An upgraded Gizumon war machine. It flies on blade wings and never stops hunting.
cobbleeffort.species.gizmonxt.name: Gizmon: XT
cobbleeffort.species.gladimon.desc: A gladiator ball that swings two sabres on hoses. It fights only for honour.
cobbleeffort.species.gladimon.name: Gladimon
cobbleeffort.species.goatmon.desc: The Armor Digimon of the scroll. It reads ancient spells from the scroll between its horns.
cobbleeffort.species.goatmon.name: Goatmon
cobbleeffort.species.goburimon.desc: A goblin who loves causing trouble. It swings its club at anything it doesn't like.
cobbleeffort.species.goburimon.name: Goburimon
cobbleeffort.species.goddramon.desc: One of the Four Great Dragons, holy dragon-god of the west. Its light burns away evil.
cobbleeffort.species.goddramon.name: Goddramon
Goddramon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its blue robe glows with sacred power.
cobbleeffort.species.gogmamon.desc: A golem of ore and crystal. It smashes mountains to pieces with its crystal fist.
cobbleeffort.species.gogmamon.name: Gogmamon
cobbleeffort.species.gokimon.desc: A huge cockroach that can survive anything. Wherever it goes, filth follows.
cobbleeffort.species.gokimon.name: Gokimon
cobbleeffort.species.gokumon.desc: The warden of a digital hell. Its scythe-blades and cannon keep the damned in their cells.
cobbleeffort.species.gokumon.name: Gokumon
cobbleeffort.species.gokuwmon.desc: The rebel monkey king of the Saiyu Warriors. It spins its iron staff and laughs at any foe.
cobbleeffort.species.gokuwmon.name: Gokuwmon
cobbleeffort.species.goldnumemon.desc: A Numemon of solid gold. It flies on golden wings and showers its foes with gold dust.
cobbleeffort.species.goldnumemon.name: Gold Numemon
cobbleeffort.species.goldnumemonultimate: A Gold Numemon grown to the Ultimate level. They say seeing one brings a lifetime of luck.
cobbleeffort.species.goldvdramon.desc: The Armor Digimon of miracles. Its golden body is said to have been born from a miracle.
cobbleeffort.species.goldvdramon.name: Gold V-dramon
cobbleeffort.species.golemjijikamemon.de: Old Jiji Kamemon at the controls of a stone golem. It is slow but immensely strong.
cobbleeffort.species.golemon.desc: An ancient golem built to guard a temple. It keeps watch even after the temple has crumbled.
cobbleeffort.species.golemon.name: Golemon
cobbleeffort.species.golemonps.desc: A Golemon made of glowing wireframe blocks, as seen in an old video game.
cobbleeffort.species.golemonps.name: Golemon (PS)
cobbleeffort.species.gomamon.desc: A cheerful seal-pup who can call fish to help it. It loves to joke around.
cobbleeffort.species.gomamon.name: Gomamon
cobbleeffort.species.gomamonxantibody.de: Gomamon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its red mane bristles when it gets serious.
cobbleeffort.species.gorimon.desc: A yeti-gorilla with a cannon arm. It fires energy shots and pounds its chest to scare foes.
cobbleeffort.species.gorimon.name: Gorimon
cobbleeffort.species.goromon.desc: A little pebble with one big eye. It rolls around and bonks into things.
cobbleeffort.species.goromon.name: Goromon
cobbleeffort.species.gottsumon.desc: A little pile of rocks with a big heart. It throws stones at anyone who teases it.
cobbleeffort.species.gottsumon.name: Gottsumon
Gottsumon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its rocks fused into a single golem body.
cobbleeffort.species.gracenovamon.desc: A god of the sun and moon combined. Its light and dark powers are said to create new galaxies.
cobbleeffort.species.gracenovamon.name: Grace Novamon
cobbleeffort.species.grademon.desc: A swordsman knight of honour. Its two blades strike faster than the eye can follow.
cobbleeffort.species.grademon.name: Grademon
cobbleeffort.species.grademonvice.desc: A Grademon who turned to darkness. Its single blade cuts down anyone in its way.
cobbleeffort.species.grademonvice.name: Grademon (Vice)
cobbleeffort.species.granddracumon.desc: The vampire king riding his monstrous beast. It drains the life of everything around it.
cobbleeffort.species.granddracumon.name: Grand Dracumon
cobbleeffort.species.grandgalemon.desc: Galemon grown into an armoured storm knight. Its war-hammer calls down thunder with each blow.
cobbleeffort.species.grandgalemon.name: Grand Galemon
cobbleeffort.species.grandgeneramon.desc: An overlord carried into battle by a monstrous beast. Its riders command it to swallow whole armies.
cobbleeffort.species.grandgeneramon.name: Grand Generamon
cobbleeffort.species.grandiskuwagamon.de: A stag-beetle titan of destruction. Its glowing blade-mandibles can cut through dimensions.
cobbleeffort.species.grandiskuwagamonhon: Grandis Kuwagamon in Honey Mode. Its armour turns gold and its four blade-wings blaze orange.
cobbleeffort.species.grandlocomon.desc: The dark train that rides the rails between worlds. Its drill-wheel grinds through anything in its path.
cobbleeffort.species.grandlocomon.name: Grand Locomon
cobbleeffort.species.grankuwagamon.desc: A gigantic stag beetle. Its jagged mandibles can tear a mountain in two.
cobbleeffort.species.grankuwagamon.name: Gran Kuwagamon
cobbleeffort.species.grappuleomon.desc: A lion-man who has mastered the art of grappling. His spinning fists create vortexes of wind.
cobbleeffort.species.grappuleomon.name: Grappu Leomon
cobbleeffort.species.gravimon.desc: A gaunt giant that bends gravity. Anything near it is crushed into the ground.
cobbleeffort.species.gravimon.name: Gravimon
cobbleeffort.species.gravimondarknessmod: Gravimon unleashed in darkness. Its wings crackle with lightning and its cables pull down the sky.
cobbleeffort.species.greatgryzmon.desc: A great grizzly whose gauntlet blazes with fire. One punch can level a forest.
cobbleeffort.species.greatgryzmon.name: Great Gryzmon
cobbleeffort.species.greatkingscumon.des: The self-proclaimed king of all sludge. It wears a crown made of a ruined castle.
cobbleeffort.species.greyknightsmon.desc: A dark knight riding a dragon beast. It charges through its foes with its lance-drill.
cobbleeffort.species.greyknightsmon.name: Grey Knightsmon
cobbleeffort.species.greymon.desc: A giant dinosaur Digimon whose skull is armoured with a helmet of hardened bone. Its Mega Flame melts rock; even a herd of the strongest beasts scatters when it roars.
cobbleeffort.species.greymon.name: Greymon
cobbleeffort.species.greymonash.desc: An ash-grey Greymon from an old virtual pet. Its flames burn as hot as any other Greymon's.
cobbleeffort.species.greymonash.name: Greymon (Ash)
cobbleeffort.species.greymonblue.desc: A blue Greymon with black stripes. It is fiercer than the usual orange kind.
cobbleeffort.species.greymonblue.name: Greymon (Blue)
cobbleeffort.species.greymonbluexantibod: A blue Greymon awakened by the X-Antibody. Red X-shaped scars cover its body.
cobbleeffort.species.greymongerosionmode: Greymon being eaten away by a corrupting darkness. It rampages in pain, burning everything it sees.
cobbleeffort.species.greymonorange.desc: A deep orange Greymon from an old virtual pet, with a silver helmet.
cobbleeffort.species.greymonorange.name: Greymon (Orange)
cobbleeffort.species.greymonxantibody.de: Greymon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its golden body is tougher than steel.
cobbleeffort.species.griffomon.desc: A griffin of legend with an eagle's head, a lion's body and a snake for a tail. Its roar shakes the heavens.
cobbleeffort.species.griffomon.name: Griffomon
cobbleeffort.species.grimmon.desc: A devil dragon with a blazing core in its chest. It hunts with its great blade-claw.
cobbleeffort.species.grimmon.name: Grimmon
cobbleeffort.species.grottomon.desc: The Legendary Warrior of earth's human spirit. It swings its hooded mace and laughs at its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.grottomon.name: Grottomon
cobbleeffort.species.groundramon.desc: An earth dragon that tunnels through the ground. Its spiked tail mace shatters bedrock.
cobbleeffort.species.groundramon.name: Groundramon
cobbleeffort.species.growmon.desc: The Tamers' red dinosaur grown up. Its elbow blades slice through steel.
cobbleeffort.species.growmon.name: Growmon
cobbleeffort.species.growmonorange.desc: An orange Growmon. It is calmer than the red kind but just as strong.
cobbleeffort.species.growmonorange.name: Growmon (Orange)
cobbleeffort.species.growmonxantibody.de: Growmon awakened by the X-Antibody. It stands upright and slashes with long claws.
cobbleeffort.species.gryzmon.desc: A blue grizzly with spiked gauntlets. It charges through the forest crushing everything.
cobbleeffort.species.gryzmon.name: Gryzmon
cobbleeffort.species.guardromon.desc: A walking boiler robot that protects its friends. It fires its rocket fists at intruders.
cobbleeffort.species.guardromon.name: Guardromon
cobbleeffort.species.guardromongold.desc: A rare golden Guardromon. Its shining body is worth a fortune.
cobbleeffort.species.guardromongold.name: Guardromon (Gold)
cobbleeffort.species.guidemon.desc: A guide who appears to lost travellers in the digital world. It shows the way on its screen face.
cobbleeffort.species.guidemon.name: Guidemon
cobbleeffort.species.guilmon.desc: A red dinosaur born from a child's drawing. It loves bread and playing hide-and-seek.
cobbleeffort.species.guilmon.name: Guilmon
cobbleeffort.species.guilmonxantibody.de: Guilmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its body became sleeker and its claws longer.
cobbleeffort.species.gulfmon.desc: A Demon Lord chimera born of corrupted data. It devours the data of everything around it.
cobbleeffort.species.gulfmon.name: Gulfmon
cobbleeffort.species.gulusgammamon.desc: Gammamon grown into a dark dragon-man. It fights fiercely to protect its partner.
cobbleeffort.species.gulusgammamon.name: Gulus Gammamon
cobbleeffort.species.gumdramon.desc: A mischievous little dragon. It bonks anyone it doesn't like with its hammer tail.
cobbleeffort.species.gumdramon.name: Gumdramon
cobbleeffort.species.gummymon.desc: A little jelly baby. It wobbles happily and sticks to anything it touches.
cobbleeffort.species.gummymon.name: Gummymon
cobbleeffort.species.gundramon.desc: A gun dragon bristling with revolvers. It fires them all at once in a storm of bullets.
cobbleeffort.species.gundramon.name: Gundramon
cobbleeffort.species.gurimon.desc: Gammamon's baby form. It headbutts with its little horn when it's grumpy.
cobbleeffort.species.gurimon.name: Gurimon
cobbleeffort.species.gururumon.desc: A wild cousin of Garurumon. It hunts in the snowy wastes with red, glinting eyes.
cobbleeffort.species.gururumon.name: Gururumon
cobbleeffort.species.gusokumon.desc: An armoured isopod of the deep. It fires jets of water hard enough to cut stone.
cobbleeffort.species.gusokumon.name: Gusokumon
cobbleeffort.species.gyukimon.desc: An ox-demon wrapped in talismans. The cannons on its back fire cursed green fire.
cobbleeffort.species.gyukimon.name: Gyukimon
cobbleeffort.species.habakirimon.desc: A sword god of legend. With one swing of its sacred blade it is said to have cut down an eight- headed serpent.
cobbleeffort.species.habakirimon.name: Habakirimon
cobbleeffort.species.hagurumon.desc: A living cog. It turns endlessly and slips into machines to make them run wild.
cobbleeffort.species.hagurumon.name: Hagurumon
Hagurumon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its drills bore into anything it touches.
cobbleeffort.species.hakubamon.desc: A white holy horse. Its prayer beads ward off evil spirits.
cobbleeffort.species.hakubamon.name: Hakubamon
cobbleeffort.species.hangyomon.desc: A fish-man warrior who fights with a harpoon. It can breathe on land through its tube.
cobbleeffort.species.hangyomon.name: Hangyomon
cobbleeffort.species.hanimon.desc: A little clay haniwa. It hums a strange tune that makes listeners sleepy.
cobbleeffort.species.hanimon.name: Hanimon
cobbleeffort.species.hanumon.desc: A monkey brawler with a golden mane. It swings its bone club with wild abandon.
cobbleeffort.species.hanumon.name: Hanumon
cobbleeffort.species.harpymon.desc: The Armor Digimon of sincerity. It flies faster than the wind on its white wings.
cobbleeffort.species.harpymon.name: Harpymon
cobbleeffort.species.hawkmon.desc: A little red hawk of good manners. It flies into battle wearing its goggles.
cobbleeffort.species.hawkmon.name: Hawkmon
cobbleeffort.species.heavyleomon.desc: A lion in heavy machinery armour. Its tower-shield arm can withstand any blow.
cobbleeffort.species.heavyleomon.name: Heavy Leomon
cobbleeffort.species.heavymetaldramon.de: A wicked metal dragon. Its breath freezes and corrodes at the same time.
cobbleeffort.species.heliosboamon.desc: A sun serpent wrapped round a golden ring. It glows like the noon sun.
cobbleeffort.species.heliosboamon.name: Helios Boamon
cobbleeffort.species.helloogarmon.desc: A wolf-beast of hellfire. Wherever it runs, the ground is left scorched.
cobbleeffort.species.helloogarmon.name: Helloogarmon
A great Hercules beetle. Its giga-blaster can wipe out a mountain.
cobbleeffort.species.heraklekabuterimonx: Herakle Kabuterimon awakened by the X-Antibody. It raises a radiant orb of lightning.
cobbleeffort.species.herissmon.desc: A hedgehog with spiky golden quills. It curls up into a ball when frightened.
cobbleeffort.species.herissmon.name: Herissmon
cobbleeffort.species.hermmon.desc: A heavy-armoured messenger. Its tall crested helm blazes with small flames.
cobbleeffort.species.hermmon.name: Hermmon
cobbleeffort.species.heshouwushou.desc: An old mountain sage. It has lived so long its head has turned into a tree.
cobbleeffort.species.heshouwushou.name: Heshouwushou
cobbleeffort.species.hexeblaumon.desc: An ice witch-knight. Its blades of crystal freeze anything they cut.
cobbleeffort.species.hexeblaumon.name: Hexeblaumon
cobbleeffort.species.hiandromon.desc: A high-grade android. It fights with its giant claw and two extra heads.
cobbleeffort.species.hiandromon.name: Hi Andromon
cobbleeffort.species.hicommandramon.desc: A heavy trooper dragon of the D-Brigade. It holds the line with its riot shield.
cobbleeffort.species.hicommandramon.name: Hi-Commandramon
cobbleeffort.species.himugendramon.desc: A crimson Mugendramon built for war. Its cannons can level a city.
cobbleeffort.species.himugendramon.name: Hi Mugendramon
cobbleeffort.species.hippogriffomon.desc: A hippogriff of legend. Its cry echoes through the heavens.
cobbleeffort.species.hippogriffomon.name: Hippogriffomon
cobbleeffort.species.hisyaryumon.desc: An eastern dragon who carries two sacred orbs. It flies across the sky like a shooting star.
cobbleeffort.species.hisyaryumon.name: Hisyaryumon
cobbleeffort.species.hivisionmonitamon.d: A ninja whose head is a wide-screen monitor. It shows enemies their own worst fears.
cobbleeffort.species.hiyarimon.desc: A ghostly drop of snow. Its icy drool freezes anything it touches.
cobbleeffort.species.hiyarimon.name: Hiyarimon
cobbleeffort.species.holsmon.desc: The Armor Digimon of love. It soars on its blade-wings to protect the weak.
cobbleeffort.species.holsmon.name: Holsmon
cobbleeffort.species.holyangemon.desc: An archangel with eight wings. Its Heaven's Gate swallows evil into another dimension.
cobbleeffort.species.holyangemon.name: Holy Angemon
cobbleeffort.species.holyangemonpriestmo: Holy Angemon as a priest. It heals the hearts of those who have lost their way.
cobbleeffort.species.holydigitamamon.des: A holy egg known only from an old virtual-pet sprite. Light shines from its shell.
cobbleeffort.species.holydramon.desc: One of the Four Great Dragons, holy dragon of mercy. Its light purifies all evil.
cobbleeffort.species.holydramon.name: Holydramon
cobbleeffort.species.holydramonxantibody: Holydramon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its holy light burns brighter than ever.
cobbleeffort.species.honeybeemon.desc: The Armor Digimon of sincerity. It fights bravely with its huge clawed fists.
cobbleeffort.species.honeybeemon.name: Honeybeemon
cobbleeffort.species.hookmon.desc: A pirate captain who sails the Net Ocean. Its golden hook and bell-mouthed gauntlet plunder any data it finds.
cobbleeffort.species.hookmon.name: Hookmon
cobbleeffort.species.hopmon.desc: A Baby Digimon with a tuft like a drop of water. It bites with its tiny fangs when it gets cross.
cobbleeffort.species.hopmon.name: Hopmon
cobbleeffort.species.hououmon.desc: The holy phoenix who leads the bird Digimon. Its golden flames purify all evil.
cobbleeffort.species.hououmon.name: Hououmon
cobbleeffort.species.hououmonxantibody.d: Hououmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Red lightning crackles through its radiant feathers.
cobbleeffort.species.hoverespimon.desc: A spy robot riding a hovering saucer. It shadows its target silently and fires from its back cannons.
cobbleeffort.species.hoverespimon.name: Hover Espimon
cobbleeffort.species.huanglongmon.desc: The yellow dragon who rules over the Four Holy Beasts. Twelve orbs of light circle its golden armour.
cobbleeffort.species.huanglongmon.name: Huanglongmon
cobbleeffort.species.huanglongmonruinmod: Huanglongmon fallen to ruin. Its three heads breathe cold blue fire that devours the land.
cobbleeffort.species.huankunmon.desc: A great fish of legend that becomes a bird. When it spreads its feathered fins it flies across the sky.
cobbleeffort.species.huankunmon.name: Huankunmon
cobbleeffort.species.hubmon.desc: A serpent of cables with a hub for a head. It plugs its tail into machines to link them together.
cobbleeffort.species.hubmon.name: Hubmon
cobbleeffort.species.huckmon.desc: A little dragon who dreams of becoming a Royal Knight. Its red scarf streams behind it like a cape.
cobbleeffort.species.huckmon.name: Huckmon
cobbleeffort.species.hudiemon.desc: A butterfly fairy. The scales of its wings scatter a dazzling light that charms its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.hudiemon.name: Hudiemon
cobbleeffort.species.hustlenanimon.desc: A brawling Nanimon who wears a trophy as a hat. It throws punches at anyone who looks its way.
cobbleeffort.species.hustlenanimon.name: Hustle Nanimon
cobbleeffort.species.hydramon.desc: A many-headed plant hydra. Cut off a head and two more sprout from its tangled vines.
cobbleeffort.species.hydramon.name: Hydramon
cobbleeffort.species.hyemon.desc: A hyena cub that laughs as it fights. It never lets go once its fangs sink in.
cobbleeffort.species.hyemon.name: Hyemon
cobbleeffort.species.hyokomon.desc: A chick who dreams of being a samurai. It swings its little katana with all its might.
cobbleeffort.species.hyokomon.name: Hyokomon
cobbleeffort.species.hyougamon.desc: An ice ogre from the frozen mountains. It smashes its foes with a great club of ice.
cobbleeffort.species.hyougamon.name: Hyougamon
cobbleeffort.species.icedevimon.desc: A fallen angel of ice. Its touch freezes the heart of any who fall into its grasp.
cobbleeffort.species.icedevimon.name: Ice Devimon
cobbleeffort.species.icedevimondaipenmon: Daipenmon after absorbing Ice Devimon's data. A fanged maw has opened across its belly and devil wings sprout from its back.
cobbleeffort.species.icedevimonenhanceme: Ice Devimon after absorbing enhancement data. One arm has swollen into a giant claw of ice.
cobbleeffort.species.icemon.desc: A little golem of ice blocks. It grins wide as it throws snowballs hard as stone.
cobbleeffort.species.icemon.name: Icemon
cobbleeffort.species.igamon.desc: A ninja of the Iga school. It rides its great shuriken and vanishes in a puff of smoke.
cobbleeffort.species.igamon.name: Igamon
cobbleeffort.species.iguneetmon.desc: A punk lizard who swings a hoop blade bigger than itself. It picks fights with anyone stronger.
cobbleeffort.species.iguneetmon.name: Iguneetmon
cobbleeffort.species.ikkakumon.desc: A walrus beast of the frozen seas. It fires its horn like a torpedo and grows a new one at once.
cobbleeffort.species.ikkakumon.name: Ikkakumon
cobbleeffort.species.imperialdramondrago: The ancient emperor dragon of legend. The Positron Laser on its back can wipe out a whole army.
An Imperialdramon gone berserk with power. Its black armour devours the light.
cobbleeffort.species.imperialdramonfight: The emperor dragon standing as a warrior. It wields the Positron Laser on its arm.
The black emperor dragon as a warrior. It answers to no one and fights for itself alone.
cobbleeffort.species.imperialdramonpalad: The emperor dragon reborn as a holy knight. Its Omega Blade cuts through any evil.
cobbleeffort.species.impmon.desc: A little devil who loves pranks. It snaps its fingers to summon fire and laughs as it runs away.
cobbleeffort.species.impmon.name: Impmon
cobbleeffort.species.impmonxantibody.des: Impmon awakened by the X-Antibody. It holds blue fire in one hand and red fire in the other.
cobbleeffort.species.indaramon.desc: A warrior deity who carries a giant conch shell. Its blast summons thunder from the heavens.
cobbleeffort.species.indaramon.name: Indaramon
cobbleeffort.species.infermon.desc: A spider of the net that eats data as it goes. It scuttles faster than the eye can follow.
cobbleeffort.species.infermon.name: Infermon
cobbleeffort.species.insekimon.desc: A golem of meteorite stone. It is said to have fallen from the sky inside a shooting star.
cobbleeffort.species.insekimon.name: Insekimon
cobbleeffort.species.invisimon.desc: A stealth warrior whose cloak makes it invisible. It strikes before its foe even sees it.
cobbleeffort.species.invisimon.name: Invisimon
cobbleeffort.species.jazamon.desc: A little machine bird-dragon. Its bladed wings cut the air as it darts about.
cobbleeffort.species.jazamon.name: Jazamon
cobbleeffort.species.jazardmon.desc: Jazamon grown into a machine dragon. The disc turbines on its shoulders blast it through the sky in a flash of blue fire.
cobbleeffort.species.jazardmon.name: Jazardmon
cobbleeffort.species.jazarichmon.desc: A machine dragon built like a fighter jet. It breaks the sound barrier and strikes with its spear tail.
cobbleeffort.species.jazarichmon.name: Jazarichmon
cobbleeffort.species.jellymon.desc: A jellyfish girl who loves to play. Its lime tentacles give anyone who touches them a nasty shock.
cobbleeffort.species.jellymon.name: Jellymon
cobbleeffort.species.jesmon.desc: The newest of the Royal Knights. Its flaming guardians fan out behind it as it raises its holy sword.
cobbleeffort.species.jesmon.name: JESmon
cobbleeffort.species.jesmongx.desc: JESmon in its GX form. Its long lance pierces the enemy before they can blink.
cobbleeffort.species.jesmongx.name: JESmon GX
cobbleeffort.species.jesmonxantibody.des: JESmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Wings of gold crystal burst from its spiked armour.
cobbleeffort.species.jetmervamon.desc: Mervamon boosted with jet power. It soars into battle with the great serpent Olympos coiled on its arm.
cobbleeffort.species.jetmervamon.name: Jet Mervamon
cobbleeffort.species.jetsilphymon.desc: Silphymon boosted with jet power. Its giant pinwheel whips up storms that blow its foes away.
cobbleeffort.species.jetsilphymon.name: Jet Silphymon
cobbleeffort.species.jewelbeemon.desc: A bee knight studded with jewels. Its star-tipped spear never misses a vital spot.
cobbleeffort.species.jewelbeemon.name: Jewelbeemon
cobbleeffort.species.jijimon.desc: The wise elder of a village. Though tiny and old, it has seen all the history of the Digital World.
cobbleeffort.species.jijimon.name: Jijimon
cobbleeffort.species.jijishoutmon.desc: A Shoutmon who has grown old. It still sings, but these days it prefers to tell long stories.
cobbleeffort.species.jijishoutmon.name: Jiji Shoutmon
cobbleeffort.species.jinsihoushou.desc: A young monkey warrior from a mountain temple. It trains day and night with its brothers.
cobbleeffort.species.jinsihoushou.name: Jinsihoushou
cobbleeffort.species.jokermon.desc: A trickster jester. Its cane spins illusions that leave its foes laughing as they fall.
cobbleeffort.species.jokermon.name: Jokermon
cobbleeffort.species.jougamon.desc: The moon goddess among the Olympos Twelve. She rides her golden crescent moon across the night sky.
cobbleeffort.species.jougamon.name: Jougamon
cobbleeffort.species.jumbogamemon.desc: A great armoured turtle. The missile cannon on its back can level a mountain.
cobbleeffort.species.jumbogamemon.name: Jumbo Gamemon
cobbleeffort.species.junglemojyamon.desc: A shaggy yeti of the jungle. It hurls coconuts with its huge hands and roars to scare off intruders.
cobbleeffort.species.junglemojyamon.name: Jungle Mojyamon
cobbleeffort.species.junkmon.desc: A plush mole that rolls around scrapyards. It builds weapons out of anything it digs up.
cobbleeffort.species.junkmon.name: Junkmon
cobbleeffort.species.junomon.desc: The queen of the Olympos Twelve. Her cape of peacock scales shines with a hundred watching eyes.
cobbleeffort.species.junomon.name: Junomon
cobbleeffort.species.junomonhystericmode: Junomon in a jealous rage. Her great golden feather blades cut down anything in her path.
cobbleeffort.species.jupitermon.desc: The king of the Olympos Twelve. It beats its golden hammers to call down the thunder of heaven.
cobbleeffort.species.jupitermon.name: Jupitermon
cobbleeffort.species.jupitermonwrathmode: Jupitermon in its wrath. Its great sword of lightning splits the sky in two.
cobbleeffort.species.justimonaccelarm.de: The masked hero with its Accel Arm. Its piston fist strikes with the force of a meteor.
cobbleeffort.species.justimonblitzarm.de: The masked hero with its Blitz Arm. Its blade crackles with lightning.
cobbleeffort.species.justimoncriticalarm: The masked hero with its Critical Arm. Its jet-powered blade can cut through a mountain.
cobbleeffort.species.justimonxantibody.d: Justimon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its giant arm cannon blazes with blue fire.
cobbleeffort.species.jyagamon.desc: A beast whose back is a heap of potatoes. It throws them like stones at anyone who comes near its field.
cobbleeffort.species.jyagamon.name: Jyagamon
cobbleeffort.species.jyarimon.desc: A Baby Digimon with two little horns. It spits tiny fire bubbles when it is happy.
cobbleeffort.species.jyarimon.name: Jyarimon
cobbleeffort.species.jyureimon.desc: A haunted tree of the dark forest. Those who wander among its roots are never seen again.
cobbleeffort.species.jyureimon.name: Jyureimon
cobbleeffort.species.jyureimonchristmast: Jyureimon dressed up for Christmas. Baby Digimon gather round its roots to open their presents.
cobbleeffort.species.kabukimon.desc: The Armor Digimon of purity. It dances like a kabuki actor and scatters lotus petals that dazzle its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.kabukimon.name: Kabukimon
cobbleeffort.species.kabuterimon.desc: A giant beetle that charges electricity in its body and fires it from its horn.
cobbleeffort.species.kabuterimon.name: Kabuterimon
cobbleeffort.species.kaguyamon.desc: A puppet of the moon princess. Its crystal blades float around it and cut down anyone who comes too close.
cobbleeffort.species.kaguyamon.name: Kaguyamon
cobbleeffort.species.kaisergreymon.desc: The Hybrid of flame united. It swings the giant sword Ryuuko Souzanken wreathed in dragon fire.
cobbleeffort.species.kaisergreymon.name: Kaiser Greymon
cobbleeffort.species.kaiserleomon.desc: The Hybrid of darkness united. Its armour is black as night and its roar shakes the ground.
cobbleeffort.species.kaiserleomon.name: Kaiser Leomon
cobbleeffort.species.kakamon.desc: A monkey who loves loud music. It dances to the beat from its headphones even in battle.
cobbleeffort.species.kakamon.name: Kakamon
cobbleeffort.species.kakkinmon.desc: A Baby Digimon that hides under a hard shell helmet. It rams into things to test how strong its helmet is.
cobbleeffort.species.kakkinmon.name: Kakkinmon
cobbleeffort.species.kaminarimon.desc: A thunder imp who loves festivals. It fans up lightning with the round fan on its back.
cobbleeffort.species.kaminarimon.name: Kaminarimon
cobbleeffort.species.kangarumon.desc: The Armor Digimon of friendship. It boxes alongside the little joey in its pouch.
cobbleeffort.species.kangarumon.name: Kangarumon
cobbleeffort.species.karakurumon.desc: A clockwork puppet that serves tea. Its hidden mechanical arms carry blades of light.
cobbleeffort.species.karakurumon.name: Karakurumon
cobbleeffort.species.karatenmon.desc: A crow tengu of the mountains. It moves like a shadow and strikes with its twin swords.
cobbleeffort.species.karatenmon.name: Karatenmon
cobbleeffort.species.karatukinumemon.des: A Numemon that crawled into a shell. Its grimace is even worse than other Numemon's.
cobbleeffort.species.kausgammamon.desc: Gammamon's wind-archer evolution. It glides on its membranes and fires arrows of wind.
cobbleeffort.species.kausgammamon.name: Kaus Gammamon
cobbleeffort.species.kazuchimon.desc: A thunder god in samurai armour. Its sword crackles with green lightning that splits the heavens.
cobbleeffort.species.kazuchimon.name: Kazuchimon
cobbleeffort.species.keemon.desc: A grumpy Baby Digimon. It puffs out little clouds whenever it is in a bad mood.
cobbleeffort.species.keemon.name: Keemon
cobbleeffort.species.kekkomon.desc: Kekomon grown a little bigger. The moon mark on its brow glows when it is happy.
cobbleeffort.species.kekkomon.name: Kekkomon
cobbleeffort.species.kekomon.desc: A spiky green Baby Digimon. It sticks out its tongue at everything it meets.
cobbleeffort.species.kekomon.name: Kekomon
cobbleeffort.species.kenkimon.desc: The Armor Digimon of reliability. It digs and lifts anything with its arm and forklift.
cobbleeffort.species.kenkimon.name: Kenkimon
cobbleeffort.species.keramon.desc: A bug that eats data. It grins and giggles as it gnaws holes in the network.
cobbleeffort.species.keramon.name: Keramon
cobbleeffort.species.keramonxantibody.de: Keramon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its many eyes watch every line of data it devours.
cobbleeffort.species.ketomon.desc: A tiny fish-shaped Baby Digimon. It splashes about happily in any puddle it finds.
cobbleeffort.species.ketomon.name: Ketomon
cobbleeffort.species.kingchessmon.desc: The king of the chess puppets. It commands its pieces from behind the lines and never fights in person.
cobbleeffort.species.kingchessmon.name: King Chessmon
cobbleeffort.species.kingetemon.desc: Etemon crowned king. Its golden armour and planet orb make it more full of itself than ever.
cobbleeffort.species.kingetemon.name: King Etemon
cobbleeffort.species.kinghangyomon.desc: The king of the fish-men. It rules the deep sea with its golden trident.
cobbleeffort.species.kinghangyomon.name: King Hangyomon
cobbleeffort.species.kingwhamon.desc: A whale so vast that islands grow on its back. Whole villages of Digimon live in its mouth.
cobbleeffort.species.kingwhamon.name: King Whamon
cobbleeffort.species.kinkakumon.desc: The gold horn oni of the Saiyu Warriors. It swings its spiked mace and hurls balls of lightning.
cobbleeffort.species.kinkakumon.name: Kinkakumon
cobbleeffort.species.kiwimon.desc: A bird that cannot fly but runs very fast. Its little Pickmon chicks explode when thrown.
cobbleeffort.species.kiwimon.name: Kiwimon
cobbleeffort.species.knightchessmonblack: A black chess knight puppet. It charges with the drill-lance on its back.
cobbleeffort.species.knightchessmonwhite: A white chess knight puppet. It leaps over its foes as a knight jumps on the board.
cobbleeffort.species.knightmon.desc: A knight in heavy armour. It lives by the code of chivalry and swings a golden greatsword.
cobbleeffort.species.knightmon.name: Knightmon
cobbleeffort.species.knightmonwiseswordm: Knightmon wielding the wise sword. It fights with blade-staff and sabre at once.
cobbleeffort.species.kodokugumonbaby.des: A baby spider full of poison. Its many eyes never close.
cobbleeffort.species.kodokugumonchild.de: Kodokugumon grown bigger. Its skull-marked fangs drip with venom.
cobbleeffort.species.koemon.desc: A mischievous jungle monkey. It swings its wooden club at anything that looks tasty.
cobbleeffort.species.koemon.name: Koemon
cobbleeffort.species.kohagurumon.desc: A tiny cog Digimon. It spins round and round when it is excited.
cobbleeffort.species.kohagurumon.name: Kohagurumon
cobbleeffort.species.kokabuterimon.desc: A little beetle warrior. It slashes with its big silver claws.
cobbleeffort.species.kokabuterimon.name: Kokabuterimon
cobbleeffort.species.kokeshimon.desc: A kokeshi doll that came to life. Its floating doll arms bonk anyone who is rude to it.
cobbleeffort.species.kokeshimon.name: Kokeshimon
cobbleeffort.species.kokuwamon.desc: A little machine beetle. It plugs its claws into sockets to recharge.
cobbleeffort.species.kokuwamon.name: Kokuwamon
Kokuwamon awakened by the X-Antibody. It flies through the sky like a jet fighter.
cobbleeffort.species.komondomon.desc: A shaggy dog who loves dust storms. Its lamp eye lights the way through any sandstorm.
cobbleeffort.species.komondomon.name: Komondomon
cobbleeffort.species.kongoumon.desc: The Armor Digimon of purity. Its six arms wield holy vajras that shatter evil.
cobbleeffort.species.kongoumon.name: Kongoumon
cobbleeffort.species.koromon.desc: A baby Digimon that hatched from a Digitama not long ago. It bounces about on its round body, blowing bubbles at anything it doesn't like the look of.
cobbleeffort.species.koromon.name: Koromon
cobbleeffort.species.kotemon.desc: A little reptile who trains in kendo every day. Nobody has ever seen its face under the helmet.
cobbleeffort.species.kotemon.name: Kotemon
cobbleeffort.species.kougamon.desc: A ninja of the Kouga school and Igamon's rival. It moves without a sound.
cobbleeffort.species.kougamon.name: Kougamon
cobbleeffort.species.kozenimon.desc: A Digimon shaped like a one-yen coin. It rolls around looking for friends to buy things with.
cobbleeffort.species.kozenimon.name: Kozenimon
cobbleeffort.species.kudamon.desc: A holy fox that lives in a bamboo bullet pipe. It is the partner of the Royal Knights' chosen.
cobbleeffort.species.kudamon.name: Kudamon
cobbleeffort.species.kumbhiramon.desc: The rat of the Twelve Devas. It whirls its ring-vajra staves faster than the eye can see.
cobbleeffort.species.kumbhiramon.name: Kumbhiramon
cobbleeffort.species.kunemon.desc: An electric larva. It shoots sticky electric threads to trap its prey.
cobbleeffort.species.kunemon.name: Kunemon
cobbleeffort.species.kuramon.desc: A Baby Digimon born from a computer virus. It multiplies across the network.
cobbleeffort.species.kuramon.name: Kuramon
cobbleeffort.species.kuwagamon.desc: A ferocious stag beetle. Its huge pincers can cut through anything.
cobbleeffort.species.kuwagamon.name: Kuwagamon
Kuwagamon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its pincers grew even longer and sharper.
cobbleeffort.species.kuzuhamon.desc: The fox priestess warrior. Its ringed staff drives away evil spirits.
cobbleeffort.species.kuzuhamon.name: Kuzuhamon
cobbleeffort.species.kuzuhamonmikomode.d: Kuzuhamon as a shrine maiden. Her prayers purify all who hear them.
cobbleeffort.species.kyaromon.desc: A fluffy Baby Digimon with very long ears. It hears everything going on around it.
cobbleeffort.species.kyaromon.name: Kyaromon
cobbleeffort.species.kyokyomon.desc: A Baby Digimon shaped like a little serpent. It hisses to look tough.
cobbleeffort.species.kyokyomon.name: Kyokyomon
cobbleeffort.species.kyubimon.desc: A nine-tailed fox. Its tails spin into a wheel of blue foxfire.
cobbleeffort.species.kyubimon.name: Kyubimon
cobbleeffort.species.kyubimonsilver.desc: A silver nine-tailed fox. Its flames burn red instead of blue.
cobbleeffort.species.kyubimonsilver.name: Kyubimon (Silver)
cobbleeffort.species.kyukimon.desc: A sickle weasel that rides the wind. The blade on its tail cuts like a whirlwind.
cobbleeffort.species.kyukimon.name: Kyukimon
cobbleeffort.species.labramon.desc: A loyal puppy who never leaves its friend's side. Its spiral tail wags whenever it is happy.
cobbleeffort.species.labramon.name: Labramon
cobbleeffort.species.ladydevimon.desc: A fallen angel lady bound in chains. She is the sworn rival of Angewomon.
cobbleeffort.species.ladydevimon.name: Lady Devimon
cobbleeffort.species.ladydevimonxantibod: Lady Devimon awakened by the X-Antibody. A grinning shadow familiar watches over her shoulder.
cobbleeffort.species.laeusgreymon.desc: A berserk winged dragon. The blue scars on its body glow brighter the angrier it gets.
cobbleeffort.species.laeusgreymon.name: Laeus Greymon
cobbleeffort.species.lalamon.desc: A little seed who loves to sing. Its songs make flowers bloom wherever it goes.
cobbleeffort.species.lalamon.name: Lalamon
cobbleeffort.species.lamiamon.desc: A serpent lady with a parasol. Her charming smile hides a venomous bite.
cobbleeffort.species.lamiamon.name: Lamiamon
cobbleeffort.species.lamortmon.desc: A hare of death. Its three blade ears slice the wind as it whirls in for the kill.
cobbleeffort.species.lamortmon.name: Lamortmon
cobbleeffort.species.lampmon.desc: A genie who lives in a golden lamp. It grants wishes, but always with a terrible twist.
cobbleeffort.species.lampmon.name: Lampmon
cobbleeffort.species.landramon.desc: A heap of living sand with a stone skull. It swallows travellers who wander into its dunes.
cobbleeffort.species.landramon.name: Landramon
cobbleeffort.species.lavogaritamon.desc: A rock bird-dragon of the volcano. Its wings shower burning ash over the land.
cobbleeffort.species.lavogaritamon.name: Lavogaritamon
cobbleeffort.species.lavorvomon.desc: A dragon of cooling lava. Magma seeps from the cracks in its rocky hide.
cobbleeffort.species.lavorvomon.name: Lavorvomon
cobbleeffort.species.leafmon.desc: A Baby Digimon that shelters under its leaf. It blows little bubbles when it sleeps.
cobbleeffort.species.leafmon.name: Leafmon
cobbleeffort.species.lekismon.desc: A moon rabbit fighter. It leaps high into the sky and punches like a meteor.
cobbleeffort.species.lekismon.name: Lekismon
cobbleeffort.species.leomon.desc: A lion warrior with a heart of justice. Its fist of the beast king blasts foes away.
cobbleeffort.species.leomon.name: Leomon
cobbleeffort.species.leomonxantibody.des: Leomon awakened by the X-Antibody. It wields a greatsword taller than itself.
cobbleeffort.species.leviamon.desc: The Demon Lord of Envy. Its jaws are so vast it can swallow a whole island.
cobbleeffort.species.leviamon.name: Leviamon
cobbleeffort.species.leviamonxantibody.d: Leviamon awakened by the X-Antibody. Blade fins flare from its back as it rises from the deep.
cobbleeffort.species.liamon.desc: A thunder lion. Its roar calls down lightning on its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.liamon.name: Liamon
cobbleeffort.species.lianpumon.desc: A showman with a cape full of masks. It swaps faces in a flash and nobody knows its true one.
cobbleeffort.species.lianpumon.name: Lianpumon
cobbleeffort.species.lighdramon.desc: The Armor Digimon of friendship. It dashes like lightning with blades of thunder on its head.
cobbleeffort.species.lighdramon.name: Lighdramon
cobbleeffort.species.lilamon.desc: A lilac flower fairy. Its petal hands release a fragrance that soothes any anger.
cobbleeffort.species.lilamon.name: Lilamon
cobbleeffort.species.lilimon.desc: A flower fairy with a kind heart. Its Flower Cannon blasts evil away with petals of light.
cobbleeffort.species.lilimon.name: Lilimon
cobbleeffort.species.lilimonxantibody.de: Lilimon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its blossoms open even wider and shine brighter.
cobbleeffort.species.lilithmon.desc: One of the Seven Great Demon Lords. Her golden claw rots anything it touches.
cobbleeffort.species.lilithmon.name: Lilithmon
Lilithmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Green rings of power burn across her tattered wings.
cobbleeffort.species.liollmon.desc: A holy lion cub. The emerald on its collar is said to hold a sacred power.
cobbleeffort.species.liollmon.name: Liollmon
cobbleeffort.species.liskmon.desc: A cockatrice covered in crystal. The serpent on its tail turns its foes to crystal with a glare.
cobbleeffort.species.liskmon.name: Liskmon
cobbleeffort.species.loaderleomon.desc: A heavy-duty lion machine. It smashes through anything with its wrecking ball.
cobbleeffort.species.loaderleomon.name: Loader Leomon
cobbleeffort.species.locomon.desc: A steam locomotive Digimon. It charges along its tracks and nothing can stop it.
cobbleeffort.species.locomon.name: Locomon
cobbleeffort.species.loogamon.desc: A demon wolf pup with a big attitude. It wears its goggles up to look cool.
cobbleeffort.species.loogamon.name: Loogamon
cobbleeffort.species.loogarmon.desc: A demon wolf grown fierce. It breathes hellfire from its jaws.
cobbleeffort.species.loogarmon.name: Loogarmon
cobbleeffort.species.lopmon.desc: A shy brown bunny. It flaps its long ears to fly and blows freezing air.
cobbleeffort.species.lopmon.name: Lopmon
cobbleeffort.species.lopmonxantibody.des: Lopmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its ears grew so long they work as hands.
cobbleeffort.species.lordknightmon.desc: The rose of the Royal Knights. Its golden ribbons cut like blades.
cobbleeffort.species.lordknightmon.name: Lord Knightmon
cobbleeffort.species.lordknightmonxantib: Lord Knightmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Wings of golden blades fan out behind it.
cobbleeffort.species.lotusmon.desc: A lotus priestess of great kindness. Her rainbow staff heals the wounded and calms the angry.
cobbleeffort.species.lotusmon.name: Lotusmon
cobbleeffort.species.loudmon.desc: A dragon living inside a mecha full of speakers. Its sound blasts shake buildings to rubble.
cobbleeffort.species.loudmon.name: Loudmon
cobbleeffort.species.lovelyangemon.desc: An idol warrior angel. Her glowing fist delivers love and justice in one punch.
cobbleeffort.species.lovelyangemon.name: Lovely Angemon
cobbleeffort.species.lowemon.desc: The Legendary Warrior of darkness. It fights with a spear and a lion-head shield.
cobbleeffort.species.lowemon.name: Löwemon
cobbleeffort.species.lucemon.desc: An angel child who once ruled the Digital World. Beneath its innocent smile lies terrible pride.
cobbleeffort.species.lucemon.name: Lucemon
cobbleeffort.species.lucemonfalldownmode: Lucemon fallen to darkness. Half its wings are an angel's, half a demon's.
cobbleeffort.species.lucemonlarva.desc: The true core of Lucemon. It flies through the dark leaving a trail of light.
cobbleeffort.species.lucemonlarva.name: Lucemon: Larva
cobbleeffort.species.lucemonsatanmode.de: Lucemon as the demon king. It crushes worlds with its black orb.
cobbleeffort.species.lucemonxantibody.de: Lucemon awakened by the X-Antibody. A storm of golden wings blazes round it.
cobbleeffort.species.ludomon.desc: A little soldier in a paint-splattered helmet. It loves to play war games.
cobbleeffort.species.ludomon.name: Ludomon
cobbleeffort.species.luminamon.desc: A little angel of light. It flaps its feathered ears to fly.
cobbleeffort.species.luminamon.name: Luminamon
cobbleeffort.species.luminamonnenever.de: Luminamon fused with its partner. It spreads one great wing of light.
cobbleeffort.species.lunamon.desc: A moon bunny that lives by lakes. Its ear-fins can hear the faintest sound.
cobbleeffort.species.lunamon.name: Lunamon
cobbleeffort.species.luxmon.desc: A little angel who always wears a blindfold. It sees with its heart instead.
cobbleeffort.species.luxmon.name: Luxmon
cobbleeffort.species.lykamon.desc: A wolf demon king from an old legend. Its howl makes the bravest Digimon tremble.
cobbleeffort.species.lykamon.name: Lykamon
cobbleeffort.species.lynxmon.desc: The Armor Digimon of courage. Its whole body is made of burning flame.
cobbleeffort.species.lynxmon.name: Lynxmon
cobbleeffort.species.machgaogamon.desc: A boxing wolf cyborg. Its rocket gauntlet fires its fist faster than sound.
cobbleeffort.species.machgaogamon.name: Mach Gaogamon
cobbleeffort.species.machleomon.desc: A lion warrior from a manga legend. It moves so fast its sword is only a blur.
cobbleeffort.species.machleomon.name: Mach Leomon
cobbleeffort.species.machmon.desc: A racing machine with a shark's head. It tears down any road at full throttle.
cobbleeffort.species.machmon.name: Machmon
cobbleeffort.species.madleomon.desc: Leomon brought back as an undead monster. It knows nothing but rage.
cobbleeffort.species.madleomon.name: Mad Leomon
Mad Leomon with a chainsaw for an arm. Its roar mixes with the shriek of the blade.
Mad Leomon at the height of its fury. Bone spikes burst from its swollen body.
cobbleeffort.species.madleomonorochimode: Mad Leomon bound to steel serpents. The snakes strike wherever it looks.
cobbleeffort.species.madomon.desc: A little dog who thinks it is a king. Its two tiny charms follow it everywhere.
cobbleeffort.species.madomon.name: Madomon
cobbleeffort.species.magnagarurumon.desc: The Hybrid of light united. It sheds its armour to move at the speed of light.
cobbleeffort.species.magnagarurumon.name: Magna Garurumon
cobbleeffort.species.magnakidmon.desc: A crimson demon dragon-knight. Green hellfire burns in its claws.
cobbleeffort.species.magnakidmon.name: Magna Kidmon
cobbleeffort.species.magnamon.desc: The Royal Knight of miracles. Its golden armour can stop any attack.
cobbleeffort.species.magnamon.name: Magnamon
cobbleeffort.species.magnamonxantibody.d: Magnamon awakened by the X-Antibody. Crystals of light edge its golden armour.
cobbleeffort.species.magneticdramon.desc: A dragon of living magnets. Its two heads crackle with lightning.
cobbleeffort.species.magneticdramon.name: Magneticdramon
cobbleeffort.species.mailbirdramon.desc: An armoured bird-dragon. It shoots through the sky like a missile.
cobbleeffort.species.mailbirdramon.name: Mail Birdramon
cobbleeffort.species.maildramon.desc: The Armor Digimon of sincerity. Its golden wings shine like the sun.
cobbleeffort.species.maildramon.name: Maildramon
cobbleeffort.species.majiramon.desc: The snake of the Twelve Devas. Its wise eyes see through every lie.
cobbleeffort.species.majiramon.name: Majiramon
cobbleeffort.species.majuulilithmon.desc: Lilithmon riding her demon beast. Its icy spikes freeze anything they touch.
cobbleeffort.species.majuulilithmon.name: Majuu Lilithmon
cobbleeffort.species.makuramon.desc: The monkey of the Twelve Devas. It loves tricks and riddles.
cobbleeffort.species.makuramon.name: Makuramon
cobbleeffort.species.mamemon.desc: A tiny Digimon with huge fists. Its Smile Bomber packs enough power to topple a giant.
cobbleeffort.species.mamemon.name: Mamemon
cobbleeffort.species.mamemonxantibody.de: Mamemon awakened by the X-Antibody. It swings its spiked fists on straps like flails.
cobbleeffort.species.mametyramon.desc: A tiny dinosaur in a giant helmet. Its claws can shred steel.
cobbleeffort.species.mametyramon.name: Mametyramon
cobbleeffort.species.mammon.desc: An ancient mammoth in iron armour. It tramples everything in its path.
cobbleeffort.species.mammon.name: Mammon
cobbleeffort.species.mammonxantibody.des: Mammon awakened by the X-Antibody. Its dark armour is even heavier.
cobbleeffort.species.manbomon.desc: The Armor Digimon of sincerity's tide. It swims with its propeller and punches with its gloves.
cobbleeffort.species.manbomon.name: Manbomon
cobbleeffort.species.manekimon.desc: A lucky cat. It beckons good fortune with its giant paw.
cobbleeffort.species.manekimon.name: Manekimon
cobbleeffort.species.maneuvermon.desc: A fox jet that outflies anything. It turns on a dime at full speed.
cobbleeffort.species.maneuvermon.name: Maneuvermon
cobbleeffort.species.mantaraymon.desc: The Armor Digimon of reliability. It glides through the sea and shocks its prey.
cobbleeffort.species.mantaraymon.name: Mantaraymon
cobbleeffort.species.mantaraymonxantibod: Mantaraymon awakened by the X-Antibody. A ball of lightning glows under its snout.
cobbleeffort.species.manticoremon.desc: A demon manticore. Its scorpion tail drips with deadly venom.
cobbleeffort.species.manticoremon.name: Manticoremon
cobbleeffort.species.maquinamon.desc: A kitten rebuilt with machine parts. Its targeting eye never misses.
cobbleeffort.species.maquinamon.name: Maquinamon
cobbleeffort.species.marinangemon.desc: A tiny sea angel. Its bubbles of love purify even the darkest heart.
cobbleeffort.species.marinangemon.name: Marin Angemon
cobbleeffort.species.marinbullmon.desc: A huge sea slug beast. Its frilled gills glow in the deep.
cobbleeffort.species.marinbullmon.name: Marin Bullmon
cobbleeffort.species.marinchimairamon.de: A chimera of sea creatures stitched together. It wields an anchor like a club.
cobbleeffort.species.marindevimon.desc: A devil of the deep sea. Its tentacles drag ships to the bottom.
cobbleeffort.species.marindevimon.name: Marin Devimon
cobbleeffort.species.marsmon.desc: The war god of the Olympos Twelve. His fists burn with the fire of battle.
cobbleeffort.species.marsmon.name: Marsmon
cobbleeffort.species.mastemon.desc: An angel and a demon fused into one. It judges good and evil alike.
cobbleeffort.species.mastemon.name: Mastemon
cobbleeffort.species.master.desc: A giant brain that rules a ruined world from the shadows. Its thoughts reach every machine.
cobbleeffort.species.master.name: Master
cobbleeffort.species.masterblimpmon.desc: A great airship Digimon. Its cannons rain fire from high above.
cobbleeffort.species.masterblimpmon.name: Master Blimpmon
cobbleeffort.species.mastertyranomon.des: The master of all Tyranomon. Its scars tell of countless battles.
cobbleeffort.species.mastervdramon.desc: A V-dramon who has mastered every fighting technique of its kind.
cobbleeffort.species.mastervdramon.name: Master V-dramon
cobbleeffort.species.matadrmon.desc: An undead matador. It dances round its foes and strikes from behind its cape of blades.
cobbleeffort.species.matadrmon.name: Matadrmon
cobbleeffort.species.mechanorimon.desc: A walking machine that other Digimon can ride. Its long arms crush rocks.
cobbleeffort.species.mechanorimon.name: Mechanorimon
cobbleeffort.species.medievaldukemon.des: A Royal Knight from a dark age. It fights with the same honour in black armour.
cobbleeffort.species.medusamon.desc: A gorgon queen. Her serpents' gaze turns her foes to stone.
cobbleeffort.species.medusamon.name: Medusamon
cobbleeffort.species.megablackshoutmonx7: Black Shoutmon X7 swollen to a colossal size by stolen power.
cobbleeffort.species.megadarkknightmon.d: Dark Knightmon grown to a colossal size. Its lance can pierce mountains.
cobbleeffort.species.megadarknessbagramo: Darkness Bagramon swollen to a colossal size. It looms over the whole Digital World.
cobbleeffort.species.megadeckergreymon.d: Decker Greymon grown to a colossal size. Its cannons can level a city.
cobbleeffort.species.megadramon.desc: A cyborg dragon twin of Gigadramon. It fires missiles from its arms.
cobbleeffort.species.megadramon.name: Megadramon
cobbleeffort.species.megagrankuwagamon.d: Gran Kuwagamon swollen to a colossal size. Its pincers can split the earth.
cobbleeffort.species.megalogrowmon.desc: Growmon rebuilt as a cyborg. Its chest cannon fires a blast of atomic fire.
cobbleeffort.species.megalogrowmon.name: Megalo Growmon
cobbleeffort.species.megalogrowmonorange: An orange Megalo Growmon. Its blades are sharper than any other's.
cobbleeffort.species.megalogrowmonxantib: Megalo Growmon awakened by the X-Antibody. Twin cannons rise from its back.
cobbleeffort.species.megamusoknightmon.d: Muso Knightmon grown to a colossal size. Its cannons roar like thunder.
cobbleeffort.species.megaseadramon.desc: A great sea serpent with a golden helm. The lightning horn on its head calls down thunder on its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.megaseadramon.name: Mega Seadramon
cobbleeffort.species.megaseadramonxantib: Mega Seadramon changed by the X-Antibody. Its bone helm bears a great curved tusk-blade.
cobbleeffort.species.megidramon.desc: An evil dragon said to bring about the end of the world. Its wings burn with the fire of ruin.
cobbleeffort.species.megidramon.name: Megidramon
cobbleeffort.species.megidramonxantibody: Megidramon changed by the X-Antibody. Its wings have become pure flame.
cobbleeffort.species.meicoomon.desc: A curious cat whose long ribbon ears crackle with lightning when it is upset.
cobbleeffort.species.meicoomon.name: Meicoomon
cobbleeffort.species.meicoomonsunnamedba: A round little cat head with a striped tail. It grins at everyone it meets.
cobbleeffort.species.meicoomonsunnamedch: A small yellow pup with long floppy ears. It follows its partner everywhere.
cobbleeffort.species.meicrackmon.desc: A nimble cat warrior. Its ribbon ears loop into a heart, and its paws glow with healing light.
cobbleeffort.species.meicrackmon.name: Meicrackmon
cobbleeffort.species.meicrackmonviciousm: Meicrackmon gone wild. Its red claws tear through anything, and its tail burns.
cobbleeffort.species.mephismon.desc: A fallen angel with a goat's skull. It lures the weak with sweet words and binds them in a dark contract.
cobbleeffort.species.mephismon.name: Mephismon
Mephismon changed by the X-Antibody. It dresses as a dandy and plays tricks with dark magic.
cobbleeffort.species.meramon.desc: A man of living flame. It burns everything it touches, and its fire never goes out.
cobbleeffort.species.meramon.name: Meramon
cobbleeffort.species.meramonxantibody.de: Meramon changed by the X-Antibody. Its flames burn hotter and its claws are sharp.
cobbleeffort.species.mercuremon.desc: The Hybrid warrior of steel. Its mirror shields turn every attack back on the attacker.
cobbleeffort.species.mercuremon.name: Mercuremon
cobbleeffort.species.mercurymon.desc: The swift messenger of the Olympos Twelve. It wears a dragon-wolf's head and strikes faster than the eye can follow.
cobbleeffort.species.mercurymon.name: Mercurymon
cobbleeffort.species.mermaimon.desc: A pirate mermaid. She swings her great golden anchor to sink any ship that crosses her.
cobbleeffort.species.mermaimon.name: Mermaimon
cobbleeffort.species.mervamon.desc: The war goddess of the Olympos Twelve. The serpent Ouroboros on her arm and the sword Olympia fight as one.
cobbleeffort.species.mervamon.name: Mervamon
cobbleeffort.species.mervamonwidehivisio: Mervamon wielding Olympia grown into a towering sword as tall as she is.
cobbleeffort.species.metaletemon.desc: Etemon recast in chrome Chrondigizoit. It sings at the top of its lungs and nothing can dent it.
cobbleeffort.species.metaletemon.name: Metal Etemon
cobbleeffort.species.metalfantomon.desc: A cyborg reaper. Its scythe of pink energy cuts the data out of its prey.
cobbleeffort.species.metalfantomon.name: Metal Fantomon
cobbleeffort.species.metalgarurumon.desc: Garurumon rebuilt as a war machine. Its freezing missiles stop anything in its tracks.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgarurumon.name: Metal Garurumon
cobbleeffort.species.metalgarurumonblack: A black Metal Garurumon. It hunts in silence and fires without warning.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgarurumonred.d: A crimson Metal Garurumon known only from old records. Its missiles burn instead of freezing.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgarurumonxanti: Metal Garurumon changed by the X-Antibody into an upright war machine bristling with guns.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymon.desc: Half its body has been rebuilt in metal. The hatch on its chest opens to fire Giga Destroyer, two organic missiles that can level a mountain, and its Trident Arm tears through steel.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymon.name: MetalGreymon
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymonalterou: MetalGreymon armed with a towering sword. It cuts down whatever its Trident Arm cannot crush.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymongerosio: MetalGreymon eaten away by corruption. Jagged magenta spikes burst from its back.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymonvirus.d: The virus MetalGreymon. Its blue body is half machine, and its claws never miss.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymonvirusxa: The virus MetalGreymon changed by the X-Antibody. Wings of violet light crackle at its back.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymonxantibo: MetalGreymon changed by the X-Antibody. Wings of blue light spread from its back.
cobbleeffort.species.metallicdramon.desc: A sky dragon of silver alloy. Its crystal wings scatter light as it fires its rail-gun tail.
cobbleeffort.species.metallicdramon.name: Metallicdramon
A stag beetle turned to living metal. Its three-barrel cannon glows blue before it fires.
cobbleeffort.species.metalmamemon.desc: A little cyborg super-soldier. Its arm cannon is far stronger than its size suggests.
cobbleeffort.species.metalmamemon.name: Metal Mamemon
cobbleeffort.species.metalmamemonxantibo: Metal Mamemon changed by the X-Antibody. A dome of crackling energy sits on its cannon arm.
cobbleeffort.species.metalpiranimon.desc: A piranha with a great steel box for a head. Its jaws bite through ship hulls.
cobbleeffort.species.metalpiranimon.name: Metal Piranimon
cobbleeffort.species.metalseadramon.desc: A sea serpent plated in gold Chrondigizoit. The cannon on its nose fires a beam that splits the sea.
cobbleeffort.species.metalseadramon.name: Metal Seadramon
cobbleeffort.species.metaltyranomon.desc: Dark Tyranomon rebuilt as a cyborg. Its arm cannon charges a ball of violet energy.
cobbleeffort.species.metaltyranomon.name: Metal Tyranomon
cobbleeffort.species.metaltyranomonxanti: Metal Tyranomon changed by the X-Antibody. A great hooked blade arches over its head.
cobbleeffort.species.metamormon.desc: A mutant of shifting data. It copies the shape and power of whatever it touches.
cobbleeffort.species.metamormon.name: Metamormon
cobbleeffort.species.metatromon.desc: An angelic machine. Its wings of key-blades lock away the power of its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.metatromon.name: Metatromon
cobbleeffort.species.mihiramon.desc: The tiger of the Twelve Devas. It races across the sky on its dharma wheels.
cobbleeffort.species.mihiramon.name: Mihiramon
cobbleeffort.species.mikemon.desc: A calico cat with one enormous claw. It slashes from the shadows and vanishes.
cobbleeffort.species.mikemon.name: Mikemon
cobbleeffort.species.millenniumon.desc: The fusion of Kimeramon and Mugendramon. Its cannons are said to bend time itself.
cobbleeffort.species.millenniumon.name: Millenniumon
cobbleeffort.species.mimicmon.desc: A living treasure chest. It waits for greedy hands, then swings its iron ball.
cobbleeffort.species.mimicmon.name: Mimicmon
cobbleeffort.species.minervamon.desc: The youngest of the Olympos Twelve. She swings the sword Olympia, longer than she is tall.
cobbleeffort.species.minervamon.name: Minervamon
cobbleeffort.species.minervamonxantibody: Minervamon changed by the X-Antibody. Two great spiked orbs swing from her shoulders.
