cobbleeffort.species.minidekachimon.desc: A little red dragon that is mostly mouth. It bites anything it can fit in its jaws.
cobbleeffort.species.minidekachimon.name: Minidekachimon
cobbleeffort.species.minomon.desc: A little bagworm that hides in a cocoon of leaves.
cobbleeffort.species.minomon.name: Minomon
cobbleeffort.species.minotaurmon.desc: The labyrinth's bull-man. Its piston drill can punch through stone walls.
cobbleeffort.species.minotaurmon.name: Minotaurmon
cobbleeffort.species.miragegaogamon.desc: A wolf knight in blue armour. Its gauntlets bite like a wolf's jaws.
cobbleeffort.species.miragegaogamon.name: Mirage Gaogamon
cobbleeffort.species.miragegaogamonburst: Mirage Gaogamon in Burst Mode. Golden energy blades flare from its gauntlets.
cobbleeffort.species.missimon.desc: A little living missile. It rockets about and crashes into things.
cobbleeffort.species.missimon.name: Missimon
cobbleeffort.species.mistymon.desc: The magic knight of the mist. It lures foes into its fog and cuts them down with a sword of flame.
cobbleeffort.species.mistymon.name: Mistymon
cobbleeffort.species.mitamamon.desc: The god beast of the four souls. Four spirit fires burn at its paws.
cobbleeffort.species.mitamamon.name: Mitamamon
cobbleeffort.species.mochimon.desc: A soft rice-cake blob. It stretches and bounces to get around.
cobbleeffort.species.mochimon.name: Mochimon
cobbleeffort.species.mockingbirdmon.desc: A mechanical bird. Its crystal wings copy the songs and moves of its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.mockingbirdmon.name: Mockingbirdmon
cobbleeffort.species.mococomon.desc: A fluffy golden cloud. It drifts along on the breeze, grinning.
cobbleeffort.species.mococomon.name: Mococomon
cobbleeffort.species.modokibetamon.desc: A Betamon look-alike from a different line of data. It shocks anything that grabs it.
cobbleeffort.species.modokibetamon.name: Modoki Betamon
cobbleeffort.species.mojyamon.desc: A shaggy yeti of the snowfields. It hurls bones and ice at intruders.
cobbleeffort.species.mojyamon.name: Mojyamon
cobbleeffort.species.mokumon.desc: A little puff of smoke with a flame on its crown.
cobbleeffort.species.mokumon.name: Mokumon
cobbleeffort.species.monarchlizamon.desc: A cyborg lizard king. Its jet boosters fling it at its prey faster than sound.
cobbleeffort.species.monarchlizamon.name: Monarch Lizamon
cobbleeffort.species.monimon.desc: A tiny television set. Its screen shows how it is feeling.
cobbleeffort.species.monimon.name: Monimon
cobbleeffort.species.monitamon.desc: A little ninja with a monitor for a head. It films everything it sees.
cobbleeffort.species.monitamon.name: Monitamon
cobbleeffort.species.monochromon.desc: A horned dinosaur with tough patched hide. It charges with its great horn lowered.
cobbleeffort.species.monochromon.name: Monochromon
cobbleeffort.species.monochromonxantibod: Monochromon changed by the X-Antibody. Its horn has become a towering blade.
cobbleeffort.species.monodramon.desc: A little dragon that hides its wings on its arms. It picks fights with bigger Digimon.
cobbleeffort.species.monodramon.name: Monodramon
cobbleeffort.species.monzaemon.desc: A giant teddy bear. Its hug fills its foes with love so they forget to fight.
cobbleeffort.species.monzaemon.name: Monzaemon
Monzaemon changed by the X-Antibody into a patchwork bear that floats on bubbles of hearts.
cobbleeffort.species.moonmillenniumon.de: A wicked god sealed in a crystal. It waits outside time for its chance to break free.
cobbleeffort.species.moonmon.desc: A little lavender droplet. The bulb on its stalk glows faintly at night.
cobbleeffort.species.moonmon.name: Moonmon
cobbleeffort.species.moosemon.desc: The Armor Digimon of kindness. Its great antlers freeze the air and calm angry hearts.
cobbleeffort.species.moosemon.name: Moosemon
cobbleeffort.species.morishellmon.desc: A slug that carries a mossy shell of the forest. It swallows anything that wanders too close.
cobbleeffort.species.morishellmon.name: Mori Shellmon
cobbleeffort.species.morphomon.desc: A little fairy-moth. The scales of its blue wings sparkle like the sky.
cobbleeffort.species.morphomon.name: Morphomon
cobbleeffort.species.mothmon.desc: The Armor Digimon of knowledge. It sprays bullets from the gatling gun under its body.
cobbleeffort.species.mothmon.name: Mothmon
cobbleeffort.species.muchomon.desc: A plump red bird. It spits fireballs at anything that teases it.
cobbleeffort.species.muchomon.name: Muchomon
cobbleeffort.species.mugendramon.desc: The infinite machine dragon, built from the strongest parts of many machine Digimon. Its Giga Cannons level cities.
cobbleeffort.species.mugendramon.name: Mugendramon
cobbleeffort.species.mugendramonmfs3mode: Mugendramon refitted for war, with a drill arm and a rail-gun.
cobbleeffort.species.mulemon.desc: A pack machine that carries heavy loads across any ground on its long legs.
cobbleeffort.species.mulemon.name: Mulemon
cobbleeffort.species.mummymon.desc: A mummy that fights with a shotgun. Its bandages can stretch out to bind its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.mummymon.name: Mummymon
cobbleeffort.species.murasamemon.desc: A beast-man bound to a cursed sword. The blade thirsts for battle and never lets go.
cobbleeffort.species.murasamemon.name: Murasamemon
cobbleeffort.species.murmukusmon.desc: A demon lord of greed. Its giant fist crushes anything it wants to take.
cobbleeffort.species.murmukusmon.name: Murmukusmon
cobbleeffort.species.mushmon.desc: A mischievous mushroom. It throws poison mushrooms and punches with its big gloves.
cobbleeffort.species.mushmon.name: Mushmon
cobbleeffort.species.mushuppedmachleomon: Mach Leomon overgrown by spores. Mushrooms sprout wherever it strikes.
cobbleeffort.species.musoknightmon.desc: A knight strengthened with heavy cannons. It fires from both arms at once.
cobbleeffort.species.musoknightmon.name: Muso Knightmon
cobbleeffort.species.musyamon.desc: A demon samurai. It cuts through its foes with a single stroke of its katana.
cobbleeffort.species.musyamon.name: Musyamon
cobbleeffort.species.namakemon.desc: A lazy sloth puppet. It lolls about all day and licks anything that disturbs it.
cobbleeffort.species.namakemon.name: Namakemon
cobbleeffort.species.nanimon.desc: A bad-tempered brawler. It hides its eyes behind sunglasses and punches first.
cobbleeffort.species.nanimon.name: Nanimon
cobbleeffort.species.nanomon.desc: A tiny genius machine. Its brain under the glass dome can repair any program.
cobbleeffort.species.nanomon.name: Nanomon
cobbleeffort.species.navimon.desc: A cheerful little navigator. It always knows the way through the Digital World.
cobbleeffort.species.navimon.name: Navimon
cobbleeffort.species.neamon.desc: A calm, slender creature. Nothing ever seems to bother it.
cobbleeffort.species.neamon.name: Neamon
cobbleeffort.species.necromon.desc: The lord of the dead. Ghosts swirl about it and its blue fire freezes souls.
cobbleeffort.species.necromon.name: Necromon
cobbleeffort.species.nefertimon.desc: The Armor Digimon of light. It guards ancient secrets and judges intruders.
cobbleeffort.species.nefertimon.name: Nefertimon
cobbleeffort.species.nefertimonxantibody: Nefertimon changed by the X-Antibody. Its bronze armour gleams in the dark.
cobbleeffort.species.negamon.desc: A mysterious blob with one huge eye. Nobody knows where it comes from.
cobbleeffort.species.negamon.name: Negamon
Negamon grown into a vast horror. Its enormous mouth swallows anything.
cobbleeffort.species.neodevimon.desc: An artificial fallen angel. Its very long arms strike from far away.
cobbleeffort.species.neodevimon.name: Neo Devimon
cobbleeffort.species.neovamdemon.desc: The vampire king reborn. Blade spines cover its glossy armour.
cobbleeffort.species.neovamdemon.name: Neo Vamdemon
cobbleeffort.species.neovamdemondarkness: Neo Vamdemon fused with a dark Metal Greymon. A dragon's maw gapes in its chest.
Neo Vamdemon empowered by its vampire army. Tattered wings spread from its back.
cobbleeffort.species.neptunemon.desc: The Olympos god of the sea. His trident raises tidal waves.
cobbleeffort.species.neptunemon.name: Neptunemon
cobbleeffort.species.nezhamon.desc: A cyborg child-god who rides the Wind-Fire Wheels. Its spear burns with sacred flame.
cobbleeffort.species.nezhamon.name: Nezhamon
cobbleeffort.species.nezhamoncrimsonmode: Nezhamon in Crimson Mode. It rides its wheels as a blazing motorcycle, a flaming blade in each hand.
cobbleeffort.species.nidhoggmon.desc: The demon dragon that gnaws at the roots of the world tree. Its energy wings blaze like fire.
cobbleeffort.species.nidhoggmon.name: Nidhoggmon
cobbleeffort.species.nightchiropmon.desc: A bat assassin. It hunts in the dark by the echoes of its sonar rings.
cobbleeffort.species.nightchiropmon.name: Night Chiropmon
cobbleeffort.species.niseagumonhakase.de: A fake Agumon Hakase. It lectures with great confidence and gets everything wrong.
cobbleeffort.species.nisedrimogemon.desc: A fake Drimogemon. Its drill is real enough, though it always looks dizzy.
cobbleeffort.species.nisedrimogemon.name: Nise Drimogemon
cobbleeffort.species.noblepumpmon.desc: A pumpkin aristocrat. It invites its foes to a ball they never leave.
cobbleeffort.species.noblepumpmon.name: Noble Pumpmon
cobbleeffort.species.nohemon.desc: A scarecrow puppet. Its crow spots trouble and its crossbow deals with it.
cobbleeffort.species.nohemon.name: Nohemon
cobbleeffort.species.nosferamon.desc: A vampire hunter-queen. Her rifle's shot leaves a trail of cyan light.
cobbleeffort.species.nosferamon.name: Nosferamon
cobbleeffort.species.numemon.desc: A slug that lives in sewers. It throws things nobody wants to be hit by.
cobbleeffort.species.numemon.name: Numemon
cobbleeffort.species.numemonxantibody.de: Numemon changed by the X-Antibody. Its grin has grown a mouthful of fangs.
cobbleeffort.species.nyabootmon.desc: A cat musketeer. Its rapier blazes with green flame as it duels.
cobbleeffort.species.nyabootmon.name: Nyabootmon
cobbleeffort.species.nyaromon.desc: A round little cat head with a long striped tail.
cobbleeffort.species.nyaromon.name: Nyaromon
cobbleeffort.species.nyokimon.desc: A seed just sprouting. Its two leaves turn to follow the sun.
cobbleeffort.species.nyokimon.name: Nyokimon
cobbleeffort.species.oblivimon.desc: A cyborg flying saucer. Its cable arms pluck memories out of its victims.
cobbleeffort.species.oblivimon.name: Oblivimon
cobbleeffort.species.oboromon.desc: A phantom samurai riding a ghost-skull of spirit fire. Its katana cuts through the living and the dead.
cobbleeffort.species.oboromon.name: Oboromon
cobbleeffort.species.ochimusyamon.desc: A fallen samurai that lost its master. It still fights, battered and stubborn.
cobbleeffort.species.ochimusyamon.name: Ochi Musyamon
cobbleeffort.species.octmon.desc: A pirate octopus. It steals treasure with one arm and fights with the other seven.
cobbleeffort.species.octmon.name: Octmon
cobbleeffort.species.ofanimon.desc: One of the Three Great Angels. Her spear pierces evil and her wings shelter the weak.
cobbleeffort.species.ofanimon.name: Ofanimon
cobbleeffort.species.ofanimoncore.desc: The core of Ofanimon. Her wings are made of golden flame.
cobbleeffort.species.ofanimoncore.name: Ofanimon Core
cobbleeffort.species.ofanimonfalldownmod: Ofanimon fallen to darkness. Red fire swirls about her as she descends.
The fallen Ofanimon changed by the X-Antibody. Spiked golden rings orbit her.
cobbleeffort.species.ofanimonxantibody.d: Ofanimon changed by the X-Antibody. Her crystal wings shine like the sun.
cobbleeffort.species.ogudomon.desc: The avatar of all seven sins. It drains the Digital World of its data.
cobbleeffort.species.ogudomon.name: Ogudomon
cobbleeffort.species.ogudomonxantibody.d: Ogudomon changed by the X-Antibody into a horror of crimson thorns.
cobbleeffort.species.ohakadamon.desc: The data of a fallen Digimon resting as a little gravestone.
cobbleeffort.species.ohakadamon.name: Ohakadamon
cobbleeffort.species.okuwamon.desc: A giant silver stag beetle. Its pincers snap trees in two.
cobbleeffort.species.okuwamon.name: Okuwamon
cobbleeffort.species.okuwamonxantibody.d: Okuwamon changed by the X-Antibody. Its long straight pincers cut like swords.
cobbleeffort.species.oleamon.desc: A carnivorous lily. Its sweet scent lures prey under its drooping petals.
cobbleeffort.species.oleamon.name: Oleamon
cobbleeffort.species.olegmon.desc: A Viking pirate walrus. It swings two great axes at once.
cobbleeffort.species.olegmon.name: Olegmon
cobbleeffort.species.omedamon.desc: A holy mechanical warrior. Its sword burns blue and its cannon burns orange.
cobbleeffort.species.omedamon.name: Omedamon
cobbleeffort.species.omegamon.desc: A Royal Knight born from War Greymon and Metal Garurumon. It wields the Grey Sword and the Garuru Cannon.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamon.name: Omegamon
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonalterb.desc: Omegamon Alter-S consumed by its own power: its armour has turned black, and red light leaks from every seam. Its Grey Sword and Garuru Cannon are said to be able to erase a whole world.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonalterb.name: Omegamon Alter-B
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonalters.desc: A holy knight Digimon in white armour. With the sword on one arm it cuts through anything; with the cannon in the lion's jaws on the other, it fires blasts of absolute cold.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonalters.name: Omegamon Alter-S
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonmercifulmod: Omegamon in Merciful Mode. Wings of icy light spread from its back.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonshuangwu.de: Omegamon Shuang Wu. It carries two great cannons into battle.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonxantibody.d: Omegamon changed by the X-Antibody. Runes glow along its blade.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonzwart.desc: A black Omegamon born from dark data. It fights without mercy.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonzwart.name: Omegamon Zwart
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonzwartdefeat: The black Omegamon broken in defeat. Its red blade still burns.
cobbleeffort.species.omegashoutmon.desc: A golden dragon-knight. Spirals of fire follow its lance.
cobbleeffort.species.omegashoutmon.name: Omega Shoutmon
cobbleeffort.species.omegashoutmonxantib: Omega Shoutmon changed by the X-Antibody. Wings of fire flare from its back.
cobbleeffort.species.omekamon.desc: A cardboard puppet decorated like a child's craft. It scribbles on its foes with its giant crayon.
cobbleeffort.species.omekamon.name: Omekamon
cobbleeffort.species.onibimon.desc: A little will-o'-the-wisp with one big eye.
cobbleeffort.species.onibimon.name: Onibimon
cobbleeffort.species.opossummon.desc: The Armor Digimon of joy. It floats along under its smiling balloons.
cobbleeffort.species.opossummon.name: Opossummon
cobbleeffort.species.orcamon.desc: The Armor Digimon of reliability. It rescues anyone in trouble at sea.
cobbleeffort.species.orcamon.name: Orcamon
cobbleeffort.species.ordinemon.desc: A fallen angel of ruin. Its twin feathered masses swallow all light.
cobbleeffort.species.ordinemon.name: Ordinemon
cobbleeffort.species.orgemon.desc: A green ogre. It swings its bone club at anyone who stands in its way.
cobbleeffort.species.orgemon.name: Orgemon
cobbleeffort.species.orgemonxantibody.de: Orgemon changed by the X-Antibody. It plays a guitar that doubles as an axe.
cobbleeffort.species.ornismon.desc: An ancient bird of vast wings. Its cry shakes the sky.
cobbleeffort.species.ornismon.name: Ornismon
cobbleeffort.species.orochimon.desc: An eight-headed serpent. Each head bites on its own.
cobbleeffort.species.orochimon.name: Orochimon
cobbleeffort.species.otamamon.desc: A round tadpole. It spits bubbles at anything that bothers it.
cobbleeffort.species.otamamon.name: Otamamon
cobbleeffort.species.otamamonred.desc: A red Otamamon. Its bubbles are hot to the touch.
cobbleeffort.species.otamamonred.name: Otamamon (Red)
cobbleeffort.species.otamamonxantibody.d: Otamamon changed by the X-Antibody into a fat little king with a tiny crown.
cobbleeffort.species.ouryumon.desc: The king dragon. Storm clouds and lightning follow wherever it flies.
cobbleeffort.species.ouryumon.name: Ouryumon
cobbleeffort.species.owlmon.desc: The Armor Digimon of knowledge. Its lenses see through the dark.
cobbleeffort.species.owlmon.name: Owlmon
cobbleeffort.species.pafumon.desc: A little fluffy puff. It drifts on the breeze like a dandelion seed.
cobbleeffort.species.pafumon.name: Pafumon
cobbleeffort.species.pagumon.desc: A mischievous blob. It loves to play tricks on others.
cobbleeffort.species.pagumon.name: Pagumon
cobbleeffort.species.paildramon.desc: The fusion of Ex-Veemon and Stingmon. It fires from the guns at its hips as it charges.
cobbleeffort.species.paildramon.name: Paildramon
cobbleeffort.species.pajiramon.desc: The ram of the Twelve Devas. Its arrows never miss.
cobbleeffort.species.pajiramon.name: Pajiramon
cobbleeffort.species.palapandashou.desc: A giant panda warrior-sage. Its roar shakes the mountains.
cobbleeffort.species.palapandashou.name: PalaPandashou
cobbleeffort.species.paledramon.desc: An ice dragon. Its crystal wings freeze the air around it.
cobbleeffort.species.paledramon.name: Paledramon
cobbleeffort.species.palmon.desc: A little plant creature. It stretches its vine arms to catch its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.palmon.name: Palmon
cobbleeffort.species.palmonxantibody.des: Palmon changed by the X-Antibody. Its flower blooms in every colour.
cobbleeffort.species.panbachimon.desc: A panda-bee cub. It sleeps most of the day with its bamboo.
cobbleeffort.species.panbachimon.name: Panbachimon
cobbleeffort.species.pandamon.desc: A stuffed toy panda. It looks grumpy but fights for its friends.
cobbleeffort.species.pandamon.name: Pandamon
cobbleeffort.species.panimon.desc: A goat-god of panic. Its cry spreads terror through whole armies.
cobbleeffort.species.panimon.name: Panimon
cobbleeffort.species.panjyamon.desc: The snow lion warrior. Its fists freeze whatever they strike.
cobbleeffort.species.panjyamon.name: Panjyamon
Panjyamon changed by the X-Antibody. It fights in steel armour.
cobbleeffort.species.panoptemon.desc: The hundred-eyed bird. Nothing escapes the eyes on its tail.
cobbleeffort.species.panoptemon.name: Panoptemon
cobbleeffort.species.paomon.desc: A soft bun of a creature. It bounces when it is happy.
cobbleeffort.species.paomon.name: Paomon
cobbleeffort.species.parallelmon.desc: A mutant from a parallel world. It reflects attacks back as if in a mirror.
cobbleeffort.species.parallelmon.name: Parallelmon
cobbleeffort.species.parasaurmon.desc: A crested dinosaur. Its crest booms like a horn.
cobbleeffort.species.parasaurmon.name: Parasaurmon
cobbleeffort.species.parasimon.desc: A parasite from the dark area. Its tendril takes over its hosts.
cobbleeffort.species.parasimon.name: Parasimon
cobbleeffort.species.parrotmon.desc: A giant parrot. Lightning crackles from its wings when it screeches.
cobbleeffort.species.parrotmon.name: Parrotmon
cobbleeffort.species.patamon.desc: A small creature that flies by flapping its big ears. It puffs air at its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.patamon.name: Patamon
cobbleeffort.species.pawnchessmonblack.d: A black chess-pawn soldier. It marches forward with its spear and shield.
cobbleeffort.species.pawnchessmonwhite.d: A white chess-pawn soldier. It marches forward with its spear and shield.
cobbleeffort.species.pawngaossmon.desc: Gaossmon drafted as a pawn soldier. It bites anything that gets too close.
cobbleeffort.species.pawngaossmon.name: Pawn Gaossmon
cobbleeffort.species.pawnshoutmon.desc: Shoutmon drafted as a pawn soldier. It sings even on the march.
cobbleeffort.species.pawnshoutmon.name: Pawn Shoutmon
cobbleeffort.species.peacockmon.desc: The Armor Digimon of sincerity. Its energy feathers fan out like a peacock's tail.
cobbleeffort.species.peacockmon.name: Peacockmon
cobbleeffort.species.peckmon.desc: A ninja bird. It strikes from the shadows and is gone before anyone sees it.
cobbleeffort.species.peckmon.name: Peckmon
cobbleeffort.species.pegasmon.desc: The Armor Digimon of hope. It carries those it protects high into the sky.
cobbleeffort.species.pegasmon.name: Pegasmon
cobbleeffort.species.pegasmonxantibody.d: Pegasmon changed by the X-Antibody. Its wings are blades of light.
cobbleeffort.species.penmon.desc: A stout penguin. It slides on its belly faster than it can run.
cobbleeffort.species.penmon.name: Penmon
cobbleeffort.species.petaldramon.desc: The Hybrid of wood. Its roots reach deep into the earth of the forest.
cobbleeffort.species.petaldramon.name: Petaldramon
cobbleeffort.species.petermon.desc: The boy who never grew up. It flies about with its short sword, looking for adventure.
cobbleeffort.species.petermon.name: Petermon
cobbleeffort.species.petimeramon.desc: A little ball of flame. It warms anyone who holds it, a little too much.
cobbleeffort.species.petimeramon.name: Peti Meramon
cobbleeffort.species.petitmamon.desc: A little imp with a lollipop. It plays tricks to get more sweets.
cobbleeffort.species.petitmamon.name: Petit Mamon
cobbleeffort.species.petitmon.desc: A tiny dragon blob. It puffs out little sparks of flame.
cobbleeffort.species.petitmon.name: Petitmon
cobbleeffort.species.pharaohmon.desc: The god-king of the desert. It seals its foes in its golden sarcophagus.
cobbleeffort.species.pharaohmon.name: Pharaohmon
cobbleeffort.species.phascomon.desc: A little demon koala. It is always sleepy, and dangerous when woken.
cobbleeffort.species.phascomon.name: Phascomon
cobbleeffort.species.phelesmon.desc: A devil that tempts with sweet deals. Its trident burns with black fire.
cobbleeffort.species.phelesmon.name: Phelesmon
cobbleeffort.species.piccolomon.desc: A tiny fairy with a huge spear. It drives off any who wander into its forest.
cobbleeffort.species.piccolomon.name: Piccolomon
cobbleeffort.species.pickmon.desc: A little blade-shaped Digimon. Many of them swarm together to strike.
cobbleeffort.species.pickmon.name: Pickmon
cobbleeffort.species.picodevimon.desc: A little bat demon. It talks big but runs at the first sign of trouble.
cobbleeffort.species.picodevimon.name: Pico Devimon
cobbleeffort.species.pidmon.desc: A fallen-then-forgiven angel. Its staff burns with holy fire.
cobbleeffort.species.pidmon.name: Pidmon
cobbleeffort.species.piemon.desc: The clown of the Dark Masters. It turns its foes into key chains and throws its four swords.
cobbleeffort.species.piemon.name: Piemon
cobbleeffort.species.pilevolcamon.desc: A volcano of a warrior. Its great pile-driver fists erupt with magma.
cobbleeffort.species.pilevolcamon.name: Pile Volcamon
cobbleeffort.species.pillomon.desc: A sleepy pillow creature. It lulls its foes to sleep with soft songs.
cobbleeffort.species.pillomon.name: Pillomon
cobbleeffort.species.pinamon.desc: A little round black ball with feelers. It sucks the sap from plants.
cobbleeffort.species.pinamon.name: Pinamon
cobbleeffort.species.pinochimon.desc: The puppet master of the Dark Masters. It pulls its victims' strings with a giant hammer.
cobbleeffort.species.pinochimon.name: Pinochimon
cobbleeffort.species.pipimon.desc: A fluffy chick with little wings. It tumbles about trying to fly.
cobbleeffort.species.pipimon.name: Pipimon
cobbleeffort.species.pipismon.desc: A bat-winged watcher. Its many eyes spy from the shadows.
cobbleeffort.species.pipismon.name: Pipismon
cobbleeffort.species.piranimon.desc: A pirate piranha. Its jaws strip a ship's hull in seconds.
cobbleeffort.species.piranimon.name: Piranimon
cobbleeffort.species.pistmon.desc: A racer of the woods. Its thorny wheels crackle with electricity as it speeds along.
cobbleeffort.species.pistmon.name: Pistmon
cobbleeffort.species.pitchmon.desc: A pale tadpole with long ears. It squeaks when it is hungry.
cobbleeffort.species.pitchmon.name: Pitchmon
cobbleeffort.species.piyomon.desc: A pink bird. It cannot fly well yet, but its Magical Fire is hot.
cobbleeffort.species.piyomon.name: Piyomon
cobbleeffort.species.platinumnumemon.des: A gleaming platinum Numemon. It is still a slug, however shiny.
cobbleeffort.species.platinumscumon.desc: A gleaming platinum Scumon. Its long arms throw shiny filth at foes.
cobbleeffort.species.platinumscumon.name: Platinum Scumon
cobbleeffort.species.plesiomon.desc: The great plesiosaur of the deep. Its song calms the angriest sea.
cobbleeffort.species.plesiomon.name: Plesiomon
Plesiomon changed by the X-Antibody. Its long blade fins cut the waves.
cobbleeffort.species.plotmon.desc: A gentle puppy with long ears. It wears a holy ring as a collar.
cobbleeffort.species.plotmon.name: Plotmon
cobbleeffort.species.plotmonxantibody.de: Plotmon changed by the X-Antibody. Its holy ring has grown big enough to wear round its body.
cobbleeffort.species.plutomon.desc: The lord of the underworld of the Olympos XII. Its cape spreads like wings of night.
cobbleeffort.species.plutomon.name: Plutomon
cobbleeffort.species.plutomonfusion.desc: Plutomon fused with a great beast of the underworld. It rides the beast into battle.
cobbleeffort.species.plutomonfusion.name: Plutomon (Fusion)
cobbleeffort.species.pokomon.desc: A little fox kit. It bounces about on its tail.
cobbleeffort.species.pokomon.name: Pokomon
cobbleeffort.species.polarbearmon.desc: A polar bear that loves snowboarding. Its twin cannons fire blizzards.
cobbleeffort.species.polarbearmon.name: Polar Bearmon
cobbleeffort.species.pomumon.desc: A dragon-fruit lizard. Its leafy scales are sweet but sharp.
cobbleeffort.species.pomumon.name: Pomumon
cobbleeffort.species.ponchomon.desc: A cactus spirit in a poncho. It shakes its maracas to call up spirits.
cobbleeffort.species.ponchomon.name: Ponchomon
cobbleeffort.species.popomon.desc: A little seed husk with big red eyes. A leaf grows from its back.
cobbleeffort.species.popomon.name: Popomon
cobbleeffort.species.porcupamon.desc: A patched teddy bear gone wrong. Steel spikes bristle all over it.
cobbleeffort.species.porcupamon.name: Porcupamon
cobbleeffort.species.poromon.desc: A fluffy little bird head. It flutters its wings hard to stay up.
cobbleeffort.species.poromon.name: Poromon
cobbleeffort.species.potamon.desc: A potato with attitude. It offers fries to friends and mashes foes.
cobbleeffort.species.potamon.name: Potamon
cobbleeffort.species.poyomon.desc: A ghostly little jellyfish. It drifts in the deep sea of data.
cobbleeffort.species.poyomon.name: Poyomon
cobbleeffort.species.prairiemon.desc: The Armor Digimon of sincerity. Its drill claws dig through rock.
cobbleeffort.species.prairiemon.name: Prairiemon
cobbleeffort.species.princemamemon.desc: The little prince of the Mamemon. It is small but its fists are mighty.
cobbleeffort.species.princemamemon.name: Prince Mamemon
cobbleeffort.species.princemamemonxantib: Prince Mamemon changed by the X-Antibody. It rules with its golden sceptre.
cobbleeffort.species.pristimon.desc: A stitched-up plush red panda. Its cannon arms fire stuffing at its foes.
cobbleeffort.species.pristimon.name: Pristimon
cobbleeffort.species.proganomon.desc: An armoured tortoise-dragon. The drills on its shell bore through mountains.
cobbleeffort.species.proganomon.name: Proganomon
cobbleeffort.species.protogizmon.desc: The prototype Gizumon. It scans its prey with its single lens.
cobbleeffort.species.protogizmon.name: Proto Gizmon
cobbleeffort.species.proximamon.desc: A dark knight fused with its war-beast. Its halberd reaps whole armies.
cobbleeffort.species.proximamon.name: Proximamon
cobbleeffort.species.psychemon.desc: A Gabumon dyed in wild colours. It dazzles its foes with its psychedelic pelt.
cobbleeffort.species.psychemon.name: Psychemon
cobbleeffort.species.pteranomon.desc: The Armor Digimon of sincerity. It flies like a jet and fires missiles from its wings.
cobbleeffort.species.pteranomon.name: Pteranomon
cobbleeffort.species.pteranomonxantibody: Pteranomon changed by the X-Antibody into a stealth jet.
cobbleeffort.species.pteromon.desc: A little bird-dragon. It whips up whirlwinds with its wings.
cobbleeffort.species.pteromon.name: Pteromon
cobbleeffort.species.publimon.desc: A hooded street imp. It spreads gossip on its glowing phone.
cobbleeffort.species.publimon.name: Publimon
cobbleeffort.species.pucchiemon.desc: The Armor Digimon of kindness. Its heart-tipped antennae spread warmth.
cobbleeffort.species.pucchiemon.name: Pucchiemon
cobbleeffort.species.pucchiemongreen.des: A green Pucchiemon. Its kindness heals plants as well as friends.
cobbleeffort.species.pukamon.desc: A little grey sea lizard. A flame flickers on its head even underwater.
cobbleeffort.species.pukamon.name: Pukamon
cobbleeffort.species.pukumon.desc: A pufferfish warrior. Its spiked fists can crack an iceberg.
cobbleeffort.species.pukumon.name: Pukumon
cobbleeffort.species.pulsemon.desc: A beast cub charged with lightning. It pulses with energy when it fights.
cobbleeffort.species.pulsemon.name: Pulsemon
cobbleeffort.species.pumpmon.desc: A pumpkin-headed doll. It plays pranks on Halloween with its axe.
cobbleeffort.species.pumpmon.name: Pumpmon
cobbleeffort.species.punimon.desc: A red jelly baby. It bounces about blowing bubbles.
cobbleeffort.species.punimon.name: Punimon
cobbleeffort.species.punkmon.desc: A punk-rock demon dragon. It rocks out until the whole crowd is down.
cobbleeffort.species.punkmon.name: Punkmon
cobbleeffort.species.pupumon.desc: A little blob with leaf ears. It flaps them to float.
cobbleeffort.species.pupumon.name: Pupumon
cobbleeffort.species.puroromon.desc: A little bee grub with lilac wings. It buzzes about looking for nectar.
cobbleeffort.species.puroromon.name: Puroromon
cobbleeffort.species.pururumon.desc: A soft pink baby bird. It wobbles along on its belly.
cobbleeffort.species.pururumon.name: Pururumon
cobbleeffort.species.pusumon.desc: A fluffy fur-ball with a pacifier. Static crackles in its fur.
cobbleeffort.species.pusumon.name: Pusumon
cobbleeffort.species.pusurimon.desc: A fluffy fur-ball that laughs a lot. Lightning spikes crown its head.
cobbleeffort.species.pusurimon.name: Pusurimon
cobbleeffort.species.puttimon.desc: A little cherub with golden wings. Its smile brings good luck.
cobbleeffort.species.puttimon.name: Puttimon
cobbleeffort.species.puwamon.desc: A fluffy owl chick. It stares sternly at anything that moves.
cobbleeffort.species.puwamon.name: Puwamon
cobbleeffort.species.puyomon.desc: A little jellyfish. It floats in the water with one big eye.
cobbleeffort.species.puyomon.name: Puyomon
cobbleeffort.species.puyoyomon.desc: A spotted jellyfish. It swims in loops when it is happy.
cobbleeffort.species.puyoyomon.name: Puyoyomon
cobbleeffort.species.pyocomon.desc: A little onion bulb with a blue flower. It loves the sunshine.
cobbleeffort.species.pyocomon.name: Pyocomon
cobbleeffort.species.pyonmon.desc: A fluffy fur-ball with a stalk on its head. It hops everywhere.
cobbleeffort.species.pyonmon.name: Pyonmon
cobbleeffort.species.pyontomon.desc: A jackalope with golden antlers. Its punch blazes with light.
cobbleeffort.species.pyontomon.name: Pyontomon
cobbleeffort.species.pyramidimon.desc: A living pyramid in a sandstorm. Its claws drag foes into the sand.
cobbleeffort.species.pyramidimon.name: Pyramidimon
cobbleeffort.species.qinglongmon.desc: The azure dragon of the east, one of the Four Holy Beasts. Thunder follows wherever it coils.
cobbleeffort.species.qinglongmon.name: Qinglongmon
cobbleeffort.species.quantumon.desc: An oracle of data. It reads the future in streams of glowing numbers.
cobbleeffort.species.quantumon.name: Quantumon
cobbleeffort.species.quartzmon.desc: A devourer of worlds. Its black sphere swallows the data of everything it touches.
cobbleeffort.species.quartzmon.name: Quartzmon
cobbleeffort.species.queenbeemon.desc: The queen of the hive. Her golden fan sends swarms of worker bees at her foes.
cobbleeffort.species.queenbeemon.name: Queenbeemon
cobbleeffort.species.queenchessmon.desc: The black queen of the chessboard. It commands the pieces with its hammer staff.
cobbleeffort.species.queenchessmon.name: Queen Chessmon

cobblemon.move.garurucannon.desc: The user fires a blast of absolute cold from the cannon in its lion's jaws. It may freeze the target.
cobblemon.move.gigadestroyer.desc: The hatch on the user's chest opens and fires two great missiles at the target.
cobblemon.move.greysword.desc: The user cuts the target with a sword that splits anything. Critical hits land more easily.
cobblemon.move.megaflame.desc: The user breathes a huge, blazing fireball at the target. It may leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.pepperbreath.desc: The user spits a ball of fire at the target. It may leave the target with a burn.
item.cobbleeffort_digital.digiball.toolt: Three times as good as a Poké Ball on Digimon.
